FISHER, HON. SIDNEY ARTHUR.—B.A. of Trin. Coll., Camb. He first contested Brome unsuccessfully in 1880. In 1887 he was elected, but was defeated in 1891. Re-elected, in 1896, and became min. of agricul. in Sir W. Laurier's govt., June, 1896.

FISHER, STANLEY.—Ed. at Westminster and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; M.A., 1891; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple and Lincoln's Inn (called 1890); apptd. pres. of dist. ct. of Kyrena, Cyprus, May, 1902; acted as King's advocate, May to Oct., 1902.

FISHER, WILLIAM WOODHOUSE.—Called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, Nov., 1877; ag. crown counsel, N. circuit, Ceylon, Jan., 1885, to Feb., 1886; ag. dist. judge, Matare, June, 1886, to Feb., 1887; ag. crown counsel, Kandy, Feb., 1887; crown counsel, N.W. prov., Ceylon, Mar., 1887; sec. to comtce. for drafting code of civ. procedure, June, 1887, to May, 1888; additional crown counsel, N. circuit, Jan., 1890; pres. dist. ct., Kyrena, Cyprus, 1891; ag. puisne judge, 1894; mag. Jamaica, 1895; puisne judge, S. Sttlmts., Apl., 1905.

FITZGERALD, THE HON. G. P.—Mem. of cabinet, Tasmania, without portfolio, 1888-92.

FITZPATRICK, HON. CHARLES.—Born in Quebec, 1853; Dufferin medallist, law faculty, Laval Univ., 1876; one of the counsel for the defence of Louis Riel at Regina in 1888; first returned to the Quebec legis. assem. at the gen. election of 1894, and again in 1896; solr. gen. in Sir W. Laurier's govt., June, 1896.

FLEISCHER, THODORE T. C.—Out-door offr. of customs and treasy. dept., 1st Aug., 1878; 4th clk., customs and treasy. dept., 25th Oct., 1878;
3rd clk., 22nd June, 1879; 2nd clk., 16th May, 1882; apptd. 1st class clk. in the treas. dept. in 1885, on separation of the customs from treas.; ag. chief clk. and book-keeper, treas., 9th March, 1890, to 10th Jan., 1900; ag. ch. clk. and cashier, 5th June, 1900, to 31st May, 1901.

FLEMING, Sir Francis, K.C.M.G. (1892), C.M.G. (1887).—B. 1842; called to the bar, Mid. Tem., Nov., 1866; crown solr. for Mauritius, 1869; dist. and stip. mag., 1872; acted as dist. judge, Seychelles, 1874; dist. judge, Jamaica, 1876; atty.-gen., Barbados, 1878; acted as ch. just., Sept., 1878, to Mar., 1879; acted as ch. just., St. Lucia, July, 1879; priv. sec. to Sir G. C. Strahan, administering the govt. of Canada, in 1880; puisne judge, Br. Guiana, 1881; acted as atty.-gen., Aug. to Nov., 1882; Queen's advoc., Ceylon, 1883; atty.-gen., 1884; acted as ch. just., Mar. to Dee., 1885; col. sec., Natal, July, 1886, but did not take up apptn., being apptd. col. sec. of Mauritius, Dec., 1886; administd. govt., July, 1887, to Dee., 1888; col. sec. Hong Kong, 1889; administd. the govt., Feb. to Dec., 1890; gov. S. Leone, 1892; ditto, Leeward Is., 1895; ret. 1901.

FLEMING, Sir Sandford, K.C.M.G. (1897), C.E., C.M.G. (1877), LL.D. (St. Andrews, 1884)—B. 1827; engnr.-in-ch., Northern Railway, Canada, 1836 to 1863; deleg. to Canadian and Br. govt. from Red River settlers, 1863, in reference to Pacific Rly.; nominated by provs. of Canada, N. Brunswick and N. Scotia; gov't. engnr.-in-ch. inter-col. rly., 1863; engnr.-in-ch., Canadian Pacific rly., 1871 to 1880; elected chancellor, Queen's Univ., Canada, 1880; re-elected 1883, and again 1886; deleg. from Canadian inst. and Amer. meteorological soc., N. York, to internat. geograph. congress at Venice, 1881; representing the Dominion of Canada at internat. prime meridian confce., Washington, 1884; dir. Hudson Bay Co., Canadian Pacific rly., etc.; author of "The Intercol., an Historical Sketch," 1876, "Old to New Westminster," 1884, memoirs on "A Prime Meridian for all Nations," "Universal Time," and various other wks.; deleg. to col. confce., 1887; representative of Canada, col. confce., Ottawa, 1894; on special mission to Hawaii, 1894, with Mr. Mercer of the C.O., negotiating for landing place for Pacific cable.

FLETCHER, A. G. M.—Ed. Cheltenham Coll. and Trin. Coll., Oxford; cadet, Hong Kong, 1901; ag. asst. registr. gen., 1903-4; ag. asst. col. sec., 1905-6.

FLETCHER, Geo. Wm.—Temporarily employed in Imp. commissariat, Hobart, 1851; clk., col. treasv., Hobart, July, 1852; receiver and paymr., Jan., 1886.

FLETCHER, Stanley Hewitt.—Mem. Inst. Chartd. Acctnts., 1892; 2nd acctnt., Br. C. Africa Prot., June, 1893; collnr., Zomba (dist.), Apl., 1900; British vice-consul and admnstr. agt., Chinde, Jan., 1901 (Cent. Africa medal and clasp).

FLETCHER, Wm., D.S.O., Surgeon, capt. militia med. staff corps; 6 mos. in 1898 attached to regulars at R.A.M.C. depot, Aldershot; med. offr., Niger Coast Prot. (now So. Nigeria), 1898; served with Ashanti expdn., 1900 (medal and clasp); Aro expdn., 1901-2 (medal and clasp).

FLINT, Thomas Barnard, M.A., LL.B., D.C.L.—B. 1847; ed. at Mt. Allison Coll., Sackville, New Brunswick; B.A., 1867; M.A., 1872, and Harvard Univ., Boston; LL.B., 1871; barrister-at-law, 1872; sheriff, Yarmouth Co., 1883-7; asst. clk., House of Assembly, Nova Scotia, 1887 to 1891; elected to H. of C., Canada, 1891; re-elected, 1896 and 1900; clk. of H. of C., Canada, 11th Nov., 1902; recd. degree of D.C.L. from Mt. Allison Univ., 1903.

FLYNN, Edmund James, K.C., LL.D.—Born 1847, at Percé, Gaspé; ed. Quebece Seminary and Laval Univ. (L.L.D. with honours, 1873), LL.D. (Lav., 1878); Q.C. 1887; called to the bar 1873; prof. of Roman law, Laval Univ., since 1874; mem. legis. assem., Quebec, Apr., 1878; mem. exec. coun. and comsnr. crown lands in Chapleau govt., Oct., 1879, to July, 1882; comsnr. of rlys. in Ross govt., Feb., 1884, and solr.-gen., May, 1885.

FORD, Henry Francis.—Entered G.P.O., Cape, 1868; promoted to deeds office, 1872; apptd. to inaugurate deeds office at Kokstad, and served as clk. to ch. mag. Transkei; in charge of deeds office, King William's Town, 1884; ch. clk., insolveney branch, master's office, Capetown, Jan., 1888; registr. and mstr. high ct., Griqualand, July, 1890.

FORD, Joseph Charles.—Ed. in France (Académie de Douai), and by private tuition by Dr. Langley at Wolverhampton; sec. inst. of Jamaica, 1889; one of the comsnrs. of Jamaica internat. exhib., 1891, and spec. comsnr. for Bahamas at that exhib.; apptd. superint. of govt. printing off., Feb., 1891; co-ed. and compiler of "Handbook of Jamaica."

FORD, Sir Theodore Thomas, KT. Bach. (1888).—B. 1829; called to the bar, Middle Temp., 1866; puisne judge, S. Sttlmts., Mar., 1874; ag. judge of Penang, 1874, to Apr., 1876; resig. and returned to England; re-apptd. senior puisne judge, 1876; ch. justice, 1886; ret., 1889.

FORDE, Robert Michael.—Asst. col. surg., Gold Coast, Nov., 1891; ag. dist. comsnr., Axim, 1892; on special service on Anglo-French bndy., comsnr., Feb. to July, 1892; med. offr. special mission to Kumasi, Dec., 1894, to Jan., 1895; col. surg., Gambia, Feb., 1895.

FOREMAN, John.—Mont., France, L.K.Q.C.P.I. and L.M.; med. offr., Virgin Is., 1878; ag. mag., Virgin Is., 1880; M.L.C., 1880, and mem. ex. coun., 1885; ag. med. offr., Dominica, 1882-1884; med. offr., Dieppe Bay, St. Kitts, 1889-1893; med. supt. leper asylum and Pogson hosp., and med. offr., dist. 5, Sandy Point, St. Kitts, 1893; surg.-capt., St. Kitts-Nevis def. force.

FORESTIER-WALKER, Gen. Sir Frederic William Edward Forestier, G.C.M.G. (1901), K.C.B. (1894), C.B. (1878), C.M.G. (1886), Knight of Grace of St. John of Jerusalem.—B. 1844; ed. at Sandhurst; entd. Scots. Guards, 1862; capt. and lieut.-col., 1873; col., 1878; maj.-gen., 1887; lieut.-gen., 1895; gen., 1902; served on staff in Kafr war, 1877-8; mil. sec. to Sir Bartle Frere, 1878-9; in Zulu war, 1879 (ment. in desps.); A.A. and Q.M.G., home district during war in Egypt, 1882; A.A. and Q.M.G., Bechuanaland, 1884; commdd. 2nd brig. at Aldershot, 1889-90; commdd. troops in Egypt, 1890-95; western dist., 1895-99; and troops in S. Africa, 1899; commdd. lines of communication in S. African war, 1899-1901; and troops in Cape Colony, 1900-1; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, Gibraltar 1st Aug., 1905.

FORGET, Amédée Emmanuel.—Ed. Marieville Coll., Canada; called to the bar, 1871; served as sec. to council of the bar, Quebec; clk. of coun. and priv. sec. to lieut.-gov., N.W. Territ., 1876; asst. comsnr. of Indian affairs for Manitoba and N.W.T., 1888; mem. of coun. of pub. instn., 1893; Indian comsnr., 1895; lieut.-gov., N.W.T., 11th Oct., 1898; lieut.-gov. of Saskatchewan, 1st Sept., 1905.
FORREST, THE RIGHT HON. SIR JOHN, P.C., G.C.M.G. (1901), K.C.M.G. (1891), LL.D. (Camb.), F.R.G.S., F.G.S., F.L.S., C.M.G. (1882).—B.1847; Hon. Fellow of the Italian geog. socy.; Hon. Fellow of the imp. geog. societies of Vienna and St. Petersburg; knight of the Italian crown; entered the survey dept. of W. Australia, 1865; commanded exploring expeds. in 1869 into the interior in search of the remains of Dr. Leichardt; in 1870 from Perth to Adelaide along the S. Coast; and in 1874 from Champion Bay, on the W. Coast; to the overland telegraph between Adelaide and Port Darwin, a journey of nearly 2,000 miles. For these services received thanks of gov. and legis. couns., and gold medal of the Roy. Geog. Socy. of London, 22nd May, 1876, and a grant in fee of 5,000 acres of crown land; dep. survr.-gen. of W. Australia, 1876; in 1878 and 1882 conducted the trigonometrical surveys of the Nichol Bay district, and the Gascoyne and Lyons District, in N.W. Australia, 1878; acted as comsnr. of crown lands and survr.-gen.; comsnr. of crown lands and survr.-gen. of W. Australia, 1883 to Dec., 1890, during which time was mem. of the exec. and legis. couns.; in Mar., 1883, reported on the Kimberley dist.; in Dec., 1890, was sent for to form first ministry under responsible govt., in which he took the position of premier and treas., which he continuously held for over 10 yrs., resigning on 13th Feb., 1902, to join the 1st Commonwealth Govt. of Australia; was one of the representatives of W. Australia at the National Australian federation convention, held at Sydney, 1891; author of "Explorations in Australia," 1865; "Notes on Western Australia," 1883, 1884, and 1885; deleg. to col. confce., 1887; represented W. Australia at the federal convention at Adelaide, Mar., 1897, and in June of the same year was present as rep. of the col. in London at H.M.'s Diam. Jub.; again rep. W. Australia at fed. convention, Sydney, 1897; Melbourne, 1898; joined 1st Commonwealth ministry as postmaster-general, Jan., 1901; defence minister, 1901 to 1903; and min. for home affairs until Apr., 1904; treas. of Commonwealth, July, 1905.

FORTH, J. OGLIVIE.—Audit clk., Fiji, Aug., 1883; acctntt. native taxes and clk. nativ. accts., June, 1889; ch. clk. audit office, Oct., 1890; col. auditor, Nov., 1891; Oct., 1890, proceeded to Tonga to audit accts. of Tongan govt., for which he received thanks of King George Tubou's cabinet.

FOSBERY, WIDENHAM FRANCIS WIDENHAM, C.M.G. (1905).—B. 1869; cons. agt., Niger Coast Prot., 1893; ag. vice-cons., 1894-5; dist. comsnr., 1896; ag. div. comsnr., 1897-8; pol. offr., central division expdn., 1898 (severely wounded); res., Benin City, 1898; pol. offr., Bonin Terr. expdn., 1899 (medal with clasp); ag. div. comsnr., 1900; pol. offr., Ishan expdn., 1901 (medal with clasp); -div. comsnr., 1902; pol. offr., Asaba Hint. expdn., 1902; senior div. comsnr., 1903; pol. offr., Igarra expdn., 1903 (clasp); ag. high comsnr., 1903-4; ag. sec. to adminsn., 1904; dep. high comsnr., Sept., 1904, to Feb., 1905, and again in Sept., 1905; prov. comsnr., 1906; ag. col. sec., S. Nigeria, May to June, 1906; ag. gov., June to Aug., 1906; dep. gov. and ag. col. sec., Aug. to Oct., 1906.

FOSTER, E. ALEXANDER, I.S.O. (1903).—B. 1846; ed. at Kingswood Coll., Bath, and Trin. Coll., Dublin; clk., audit office, Jamaica, Mar., 1866; 2nd clk., May, 1868; ch. clk., island med. office, June, 1882; sec. of cent. bds. of health and leg. couns., Antigua; J.P., ag. col. sec., Leeward Is., Sept., 1897, Sept. to Oct., 1899, Nov., 1899, to Apr., 1900, and Aug. to Oct., 1901; admntr., Antigua, in Jan., 1898, Dec., 1899, and in Jan., Feb., Mar., 1900, also in June, July, Aug. and Sept., 1905, under dormant comsn.; holds dormant comsnr. to administer govt. of Leeward Is. in certain events.

FOSTER, THE HON. GEO. E., B.A., D.C.L.—Ed. common and superior schls., King's County, New Bruns.; Douglas gold medallist, Univ. N.B., 1866; B.A., 1868; medallist, ancient rhetoric, Edin., 1873; prof. classics, Univ. N.B., 1873-9; returned to parlmt., 1882; min. of marine and fisheries for Dominion, Dec., 1888; min. of finance, 1888 to 1896; represented Canada at col. confce., Ottawa, 1894.

FOSTER, RICHARD WITTY, M.L.A., S. Aust., 1893.—Comsnr. of pub. wks., 1899; ditto, and min. of industry, 1902-1904; ditto, and min. of agric., 1st March to 26th July, 1905.

FOSTON, EDMUND CHRISTOPHER.—L.R.C.P. (Edin.), L.F.P.S. (Glas.); col. surg., prov. Wellesley (South), S. Sttlmts., 26th Aug., 1891; supt. S. S. emig. depot, Negapatam, 17th Nov., 1900.

FOWlds, HON. GEORGE.—Min. of educn., and min. of pub. health, New Zealand.

FOWLER, CHAS. W., C.M.G. (1890).—Late R.N.; asst. collr., Uganda Prot., 7th July, 1896; supt. of marine, 1st Apr., 1898; sub-comsnr., 1st Apr., 1904.

FOWLER, FRANK.—Asst. clk., pub. works dept., Brit. Guiana, Feb., 1878; 3rd clk., Jan., 1881; 2nd clk., Apl., 1884; 1st clk. and draftsman, gov't. ld. dept., Nov., 1884; 3rd gov't. survr., May, 1886; senr. gov't. survr., Apl., 1896; apptd. J.Y., Nov., 1900; asst. comsnr. of lands and mines, Apl., 1902; comsnr. of lands and mines, 1st Apl., 1903; has held numerous acting appointments.

FOWLER, GEO. MERRICK, C.M.G. (1905).—Ed. Chelt. Coll.; writer, Ceylon service, Jan., 1874; pol. mag., Galagedara, Sept., 1876; landing survr., Galle, Feb., 1878; pol. mag., Navalapitiya, Jan., 1880; asst. collr. customs, Galle, June, 1880; dist. judge, Matara, May, 1886; asst. gov't. agt., Matara, 1887; ditto, Kalutara, 1888; ditto, N'Elhiya, 1891; ditto, Trincomalee, 1895; apptnt. confirmed, Dec., 1895; ag. dist. judge, Kalutara, May, 1897, Negombo, Oct., 1897; ag. prin. asst. col. sec., July, 1897; gov't. agt., Ratnapura, June, 1898; ag. gov't. agt., W. prov., June, 1899; gov't. agt., S. prov., Feb., 1900; gov't. agt., and fiscal, W. prov., Mar., 1902; ag. aud.-gen., Apr., 1905; ag. col. sec., Sept., 1905; ag. aud.-gen., Dec., 1905.

FOWLIS, HENRY GEORGE.—Entd. judicial dept., Gambia, 1890; gov't.'s off., 1893-1901; col. sec.'s off., 1902-05; ch. clk. and acctnt., P.W.D., 1906.

FOX, HENRY WILSON, B.A.—Ed. Charterhouse, Marlborough Coll., Univ. Coll., Lond., Trin. Coll., Cam.; exhibtn., Trin. Coll., 1882; foundation scholar, 1883; natural sci. trip.; exhibtn., Lincoln's Inn, 1888; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1888; priv. sec. to Sir C. Mills, K.C.M.G., 1887 to 1889; admitted to practise in sup. ct., Cape Colony, and high ct., So. Rhodesia, 1894; pub. prosecutor, So. Rhodesia, 1894-1897; manager B.S.A. Co., head office, London, 1898; served during 1896-97 in the Matabeleland and Mashona land rebellion (medal and clasp and ment. in deeps.).

FOX, WALTER.—Asst. supt., botanic gardens, Singapore, 16th June, 1879; supt., forests and gardens, Penang, 7th Dec., 1903.
FOXON, Cuthbert Colenso.—Cik. and Zulu interp. to asst. comsnr. and res. mag. Ndandwe dist., Zululand, Sept., 1887; transfd. to Entonjaneni dist., Apl., 1891; to Lower Umfolosi dist., Feb., 1892; ag. res. mag. there Mar., 1892; ag. sub-inspr. Z'land. pol. for six months, May, 1892, and Apl., 1893; transfd. as cik. and Zulu interp. to Nkandhla dist. Nov., 1892; sub-inspr. Z'land. pol., Apl., 1893; commanded detachment Z'land. pol. with the special comsn. annexation of Sambanans and adjacent territories, May, 1895; Br. res. Amatongaland, Br. Protectorate, June, 1896; deputy comsnr., Sept., 1896; res. mag., Z'land., Dec., 1897; mag., Nkandhla, 1901; J.P. for colony, 1904; mag., Umlalazi, 1905.

FOXON, Frank Ernest.—3rd class clk. civ. serv., Natal, and 2nd clk. and Zulu interp., Umgeni div., Nov., 1880; ag. clk. of ct., regisr. circuit ct., and sub-distributor of stamps, Weenen country, 1886; clk. of ct., dep.clk. of peace, and sub-distributor of stamps, UpperUmkomangti div., May, 1887; admstr. native law, Impendlele, Mar., 1889; ditto, Inanda Location, Jan., 1890; ag. mag., Lower Tugela div., Apr. to June, 1890; ag. R.M. at Verulam and Stanger, 1890 to 1894; R.M. for col., and mag., Ndwedwe div., July, 1894; J.P. for col., 1893; served at commencement of Zulu war, 1879, in imp. transport dept., afterwards as lieut. Natal N. pioneers (medal and clasp); served as levy leader in command of Sibepeu's contingent and Yamela's mounted men against Dinuzulu in Zululand, 1888; lieut., Natal carabiners, Apr., 1889, capt., Dec., 1897; mag. Ixopo div., 1897; served through the Boer war, 1899-1900, including the siege of Ladysmith.

FRANCE, Henry Dunlop.—Rev. offr., Anguilla, 1896; govt. offr., St. Kitts, 1897; rev. offr., Nevis, 1899; tariff clk., treasy., St. Kitts, 1901; ag. audit clk., St. Kitts-Nevis, 1902; supervisor of cust., G. Coast, Sept., 1904.

FRANCIS, Col. Claude Augustus.—Ed. Craven Coll. and Vienna; entd. Impl. Yeo., 1875; C.M.R., 1876; S. African War (medal with clasp) 1877-8; inspr. constab., and armed pol. and J.P., Br. Guiana, 1880; higher grade, 1883; county inspr., 1891; acted as dep. inspr-gen., 1892, and from Feb., 1895, to Apr., 1896; ag. inspr-gen., May to Oct., 1896; sup't fire brig., 1895-6; mem. excise, quarantine, and health bds.; author of "A Manual for the Use of Police and Constabulary," "A Criminal Code," 1895, and "A Police Catechism," 1898; sheriff-commdt., armed constab., sup't civ. pol. and J.P., Fiji, 1897; marshal, V.-A. ct.; commdt., European vol. force, which he raised; localcol., 1898; M.L.C., 1905; inspr.-gen. of constab., 1906.

FRANCIS, Cyril Gerard Brooke.—Cik., G.P.O., Fiji, 1898; ditto, treasy., 1899; lieut., armed constab., 1901; in command detachment, Nadarivatu, 1902; ag. adjut., A.N.C., and inspr. pol., 1903; P.S. certif., schl. instruc., Chelsea bks.; passed course musketry and Maxim gun, Hythe, 1905.

FRANKLIN, William.—Asst. regisr., natives, Kimberley and De Beers, Mar., 1877; regisr. deaths, Kimberley and De Beers, 1878; clk. to civil comsnr. and res. mag., Barkly West, Jan., 1879; issuer of passes, Mar., 1879; inspr. of claims, Barkly West, June, 1879; inspr. of Sivonell's diggings, May-June, 1882; from Oct., 1882, to Aug., 1883, off. valuator of all diamonds exported from the dist. of Barkly West; apptd. regisr. of claims, Barkly West, Sept., 1883; inspr. and regisr. mines and diggings, Barkly West.

FRASER, Charles A.—Ed. at Wellington Coll.; entd. 54th regt., Jan., 1875; resigned, 1877; in colonial forces in S. Africa, 1878 (medal and clasp); asst. inspr., G. Coast constab., 1882; dist. comsnr., 1889; treas., etc., Falkland Is., 1891; col. sec., Falkland Is., 1893; comdt. and prov.-marshal, Bahamas, 1894.

FRASER, Duncan Cameron.—B. 1845; B.A., 1872; called to the bar, 1873; mem. legis. coun., Nova Scotia, 1878; resig. in same year; gov't. leader in legis. coun., and mem. of exec. coun., 1888; elected to H.of C.as mem. for Guysborough, 1891; re-elected 1896; lieut.-gov. of Nova Scotia, 27th Mar., 1906.

FRASER, F. Blache.—2nd clk. atty.-gen.'s office, Trinidad, Jan., 1865; promoted to col. sec.'s dept. as 3rd clk., Sept., 1867; 3rd landing waiter, customs dept., Jan., 1875; principal landing waiter, Jan., 1883; ch. clk. customs dept., Apr., 1894.

FRASER, J. J., K.C.—Atty.-gen. and premier, N. Brunswick; ret., 1882; puisne judge, sup. ct., 1883.

FRASER, Malcolm A. C.—Ed. at King Edward's schl., Bromsgrove; probation clk. in col. sec.'s office, W. Australia, Apr., 1876; 2nd clk., land and survey dept., June, 1876; transfd. to col. sec.'s office, Aug., 1877; clk. and assist. priv. sec. to gov', July, 1878; also asst. clk. to the exec. coun.; clk. to gov', Sir W. C. F. Robinson, K.C.M.G., Apr., 1880; corresp. clk., col. sec.'s office, Jan., 1881; also meteorological reporter; regisr.-gen., 1891; also regisr. of patents, trade mks., etc.; represented the gov't. of W. Aust. at the conference of gov't. statisticians apptd. to arrange for a uniform census of Australia, Sydney, Jan., 1900; supt. of census, Western Australia, 1900; gov't. statistician, 1901; represented W.A. at conference of statisticians convened to arrange for uniformity in the collection and compilation of statistics throughout the Commonwealth of Aust.

FRASER, Major-Gen. Sir Thomas, K.C.B. (1900), R.E., C.M.G. (1882).—B. 1840; apptd. C.M.G. for civ. services in connection with the settlement of the Transvaal question; served in expdrny. force in Egypt, 1882, and in the Nile expdrny. force, 1884, with brevet rank 4th class Osmanieh, and 3rd class of col.; Medjidie.

FRASER, William.—King's student, Aberdeen Univ., 1899-1901; M.A., ditto, 1901; privy coun. certif., 1903; ass't mast., Gordon's Coll., Aberdeen, 1901-3; prin., govt. schl., Senekal, 1903-4; inspr. of schl., O.R.C., 1st July, 1904.

FREER, Gerald Dudley, L.R.C.P. (Lond.), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), 1888. M.B. (Lond.), 1898.—House surg. gen. hosp., Birmingham; house surg. gen. hosp., Singapore, July, 1890; col. surg. Malacca, Feb., 1893; col. surg. res. Penang, Jan., 1897; ag. col. surg., Penang, June, 1900; col. surg., Singapore, 1st Mar., 1901; principal, med. schl., S.S. and F.M.S., June, 1905; mem. S.S. med. coun., July, 1905.

FREMANTLE, Admiral the Hon. Edmund Robert, R.N., Sir, G.C.B., C.M.G. (1874).—B. 1836; apptd. to the Order of St. M. and St. G. for service during the Ashanti war, 1873-74, having been some time sen. naval offr. on the station.

FRENCH, Maj.-Gen., Sir George Arthur, R.A., K.C.M.G. (1902), C.M.G. (1877).—B. 1841; ed. at Sandhurst and Woolwich; joined R.A. as lieut. in 1860; proceeded to North America in Dec., 1861, with expeditionary force sent out in
consequence of the "Trent Affair"; adjt. R.A., Kingston, from 1862 to 1866; qualified as 1st class gunnery instructor in 1867; 1st class inspr. of warlike stores in 1868; apptd. I.S.W. at Quebec in 1869 on the withdrawal of the Imp. troops; inspr. of artillery, with rank of lieut.-col., in 1870; organised the permanent batteries of artillery in 1871; comsnr. N.W.M.P., and stip. mag. for the territories, in Dec., 1873; raised, organised, and equipped the force; commanded the expdn. sent from the Red River to the base of the Rocky Mountains in 1874; inspr. of warlike stores, Devonport, 1878 to 1883; comdt. Queensland forces, with rank of col., 1883-91; comdt., N. S. Wales forces, 1896.

FRENCH, JOHN K.—Cltk., poor law bd., Sandy Point, Mar., 1894; clk., P.O., St. Kitts, Nov., 1897; clk. to registr. and prov.-marshal, Nevis, Sept., 1901; govt. offr., sub-treas., Sandy Point, St. Kitts, June, 1905.

FRENCH, STIR S. R., K.C.M.G. (1901), C.M.G., (1896).—B. 1849; sec. and acctnt., G.P.O., Cape, Aug., 1880; controller P.O. savings bk., 1884; postmr.-gen., 1892.

FRERE, AUBREY TEMPLE.—Cadet, Sarawak service, Oct., 1886; asst. res., May, 1890; res., 2nd class, 4th div., Jan., 1894.

FRERE, BARTLE HENRY TEMPLE, LL.B.—Ed. at Charterhouse school and Trin. Coll., Cam.; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1887; pres. dist. court, Cyprus, 1897; transfld. to Gibraltar as pol. mag. and coroner, 1902.

FRERE, HAROLD ARTHUR.—Cadet, Br. North Borneo Co.'s serv., Nov., 1897; asst. supt. of goals, 2nd May, 1898; ag. supt. of pub. wks., 2nd May, 1898; ag. P.M.G., 16th Sept., 1898; sec. to the comsrs., 2nd Aug., 1899; ag. supt. of goals, 22nd Jan., 1900; editor "British North Borneo Herald" and manager, govt. printing off., 8th May, 1900; inspr. of prisons, 1st Dec., 1901; resig., to take up apptmnt. as supt., Georgetown prison, Br. Guiana, June, 1906.

FRETTZ, W. H.—L.R.C.P., L.R.C.S., Edin.: med. offr., dist. 2, Nevis, Feb., 1882; dist. 3, S. Kitts, May, 1886; dist. 1, S. Kitts, Aug., 1896; official mem. legis. coun., S. Kitts-Nevis, Nov., 1896; offr. mem., leg. coun., St. K.-N., Nov., 1896, to Dec., 1900; senior med. offr., health offr. and analyser of vital statistics, Feb., 1903; mem., Basseterre town bd., 1903; offr. M.L.C., 1903.

FROST, THE HON. SIR JOHN, K.C.M.G. (1904); C.M.G. (1879).—B. 1828; M.L.A. C. of G. H., field comdt. of Cape vols., and late of C.M.R.; sec. for agriculture, Cape Col., 1893-6; ditto, 1902-1904; M.L.A. for Queenstown, 1904.

FROUDE, ASHLEY A., B.A., C.M.G. (1892).—B. 1863; ed. Westminster and Oriel Coll., Oxon; priv. sec. (unpaid) to Sir Robert Herbert at the C.O., Nov., 1886; sec. to roy. comsn. for the division of Malta into electoral dists., Jan., 1888; sec. to the Behring Sea comsn., June, 1891, and to the joint Behring Sea comsn. at Washington, Jan., 1892; on the staff of the Br. agt., Behring Sea arbitration, 1892-3.

FRY, R. S.—Trigonometrical asst., survey dept., S. Sttlmtns, Jan., 1881; res. Aug., 1884; rejoined July, 1885; dist. survr., Sept., 1885; ch. survr., Dec., 1888; observer for time balls and dep. registr. of shipping, Jan., 1894.

FRY, WM. HERBERT, L.R.C.P. (Lond.), M.R.C.S. (Eng.).—House surgeon, S. Sttlmtns, 13th Aug., 1896; supernumerary col. surg., Siug., 1st Apr., 1900; col. surg., prov. Wellesley, South, 17th Nov., 1900; ditto, prov. Wellesley, North, 1st Mar., 1901; state surg., Pahang, F.M.S., June, 1905.

FULLARTON, R.—Harbourmr., Melbourne, 1877; ch. harbourmr., pres. pilot bd., and chmn. steam navig. bd., 1882; capt. comdg. Victorian naval brigade, 1871; mem. of coun. of defence, 1884.

FULLER, A. J.—M.L.A. for Tembulan, Cape Colony, since 1898; sec. for agric., Feb., 1904.

FULLER, F. C. F. D., C.M.G. (1906).—Cadet, Fiji, 1884; res. comsnr., Rotuman, 1889; dis. comsnr., Lagos, 1892; res. of Ibadan, 1897; col. treas., Lagos, 1901; asst. sec. to govt., Malta 1902; mem. exec. coun.; ch. comsnr., Ashanti, 1905.

FULLER, SIR THOS. EKINS, K.C.M.G. (1904); C.M.G. (1903).—B. 1831; emigtn. agt. in Lond. for Cape of Good Hope, 1872; resigned, 1876; served as mem. of house of ass. for 23 years; agent-gen. in Lond. for Cape of Good Hope, 1st Jan., 1902; J.P., Cape Town; has served on various councils and comtees, in Cape Colony.

FURLONG, L. O'B. M.H.A., St. John's, E. Newfild., 1893; mem. exec. coun. and chmn. bd. of wks., Apr. to Dec., 1894; M.H.A., St. John's, E., 1897; cashier, govt. savings bank, 1905.

FYSH, THE HON. SIR PHILIP OAKLEY, K.C.M.G., (1896).—B. 1833; treas. in Mr. Kenmersley's ministry, Tasmania, 1873-5, and without portfolio to July, 1876; premier without office, Aug., 1877, to Mar., 1878, and member without office of Mr. Giblin's 1st administration; maj. comdg. Tasmanian volr. rifle regt. 1880-4; again premier, Mar., 1887, to Aug., 1892; treas. in the Braddon Ministry, 1894-9; agt.-gen. for the col. in London, 1899-1900; elected to 1st H. of R. for Tasmania, 1901, and for Denison div., 1903; min. without portfolio in 1st Commonwealth govt., 1901-3; and postmr.-gen. till Apr., 1904.

FYSON, PERCIVAL WILLIFRID.—Asst. govt. printer, Perak, 1896-99; head printer, Br. Cent. Africa Prot., July, 1899.

GABRIEL, J. S., M.R.C.S.E.—Med. offr., Antigua, dist. 6, 1881.

GAGNON, CHARLES ANTOINE ERNEST.—Ed. St. Ann's Coll.; notary public, 1869; since 1885 pres. of Quebec board of notaries; elected to Quebec legislature, 1878-81, and since 1883; prov. sec., 1887; sheriff of Quebec, 1890.

GALE, CHARLES HENRY.—Assoc. M.I.C.E.; articled pupil, 1882-5; asst. and resident engr., 1890; ch. draughtsman P.W. dept., Hong Kong, Sept., 1890; asst. engr., Jan., 1900, and ag. exec. engr., May, 1900; exec. engr., Feb., 1901; J.P., 1914.

GALE, WALTER A.—Ed. high schl., Perth, St. Peter's Coll., Adelaide, and Exeter Coll., Oxon; 3rd master, high schl., Perth, 1885; asst. registr., col. sec.'s office, W. Australia, 1886; sec. to cent. bd. of educn., 1888; registr.-gen.; registr. of patents, etc., Sept., 1890; in charge of census for 1891; clk. of legis. assen., 1891; transfld. to Commonwealth govt., 1901.

GALEA, HENRI.—Master, sup. ct., and registr., Mauritius, 4th Feb., 1899.

GALLWEY, LT.-COL. HENRY LIONEL, C.M.G. (1890), D.S.O. (1896).—B. 1859; ed. Cheltenham Coll. and Sandhurst; entered army, May, 1878; promoted lieut., Mar., 1881; capt., Oct., 1887; brevet-maj., May, 1897; maj., Mar., 1899; and lt.-col., Apr., 1901; apptd. dep. commr. and consul, Niger Rivers prot., Mar., 1891; dep. commr. and consul, Niger Coast prot., Jan., 1897; and divn. commr. Niger Coast prot. (now South. Nigeria), Apr., 1899; ag. consul-gen. Niger Coast prot., Aug. to Nov., 1896; Jan., 1897; Feb., 1898, to Jan., 1899;
ag. high comsnr., South Nigeria, Mar. to Dec., 1900; Brass exped., 1895 (deeps. medal with clasp, D.S.O.); Benin exped., 1897 (deeps., clasp, brevet majority); Aro exped. as chief political officer, 1901-2 (deeps.); gov., St. Helena, 1902.

GALLWEY, Sir Michael Henry, K.C.M.G. (1883), C.M.G. (1883).—B. 1826; ed. Trin. Coll., Dub.; B.A.; barrister, King's Inns, Dub., Trin. term, 1855; Munster circuit; atty.-gen., Natal, 1857; mem. exec. and legis. couns.; pres. Transvaal and Zululand bdry. comsn., 1878; received the thanks of the sec. of state; ch. just., Natal, 1890; ret., 1902.

GARDINER, John.—Entd. govt. ser., S. Austral., in ch. sec.'s off., 1866; treas., 1871; clk., engrn.-in-chief's dept., 1874; acctnt., 1876; ch. acctnt., 1888; sec. comsrs. P.W., and chrmn. supply and tender bd., 1899; transf. to serv. of Commonwealth of Aust. as pub. serv. inspr., 1902.

GARDNER, Harry.—Major (ret.), Roy. Scots; served in Bechuanaland expdn., 1884, and Zululand, 1888; ag. col. sec. and rec. gen., St. Helena, 1886-7; ag. treas., Zululand, 1890; confirmed, 1891; acctnt. offr. for prov. of Zululand, 1891; inspr., audit dept., 1899.

GARLAND, Patrick Joseph.—Apptd. a sen. med. offr., Northern Territories, 1899; served on Fra Fra expdn., under Captain Donald Stewart, June and July, 1899; specially mentioned in despatches; served on Neutral Zone expdn., Feb., 1900; mentioned in despatches; served on Fra Fra expdn., Mar., 1900; served during Ashanti rebellion and siege of Kumasi; acted as P.M.O. to column during retirement of Sir F. M. Hodgson, governor; specially mentioned in despatches; apptd. dist. comsnr. of Axim Dist., 1901.

GARLING, Henry Chas.—Supt.'s asst., Skerrett's farm and school, Antigua, 18th Apr., 1894; ag. asst. supt. of agric., Feb., 1904; 2nd outdoor offr., treas., Feb., 1905.

GARNEAU, Pierre.—Merchant and mem. of bd. of trade, Quebec; late gov't. dir. of North Shore railway; mayor, 1870-73; M.L.A., Quebec, 1873-78 and 1881-86; mem. of prov. exec. coun. and ministry as comsnr. of agricult., pub. wks., and crown lands, 1874-78; M.L.C., Quebec, 1887, and again comsnr. of agricult., pub. wks., and crown lands to 1891.

GARRARD, C. G.—Ed. Haileybury; dep. regir. sup. ct., Penang, Jan., 1892; ag. dep. regir. sup. ct., Singapore, Feb. to Oct., 1893; ag. regir. sup. ct., Penang, July, 1894; ag. dep. regir. sup. ct., and mag., Malacca, Apr., 1895; also ag. colfr., land rev., and offr. in charge of treas., Malacca, Aug., 1895; ag. dep. regir. sup. ct., Penang, Mar., 1896; asst. regir. and mag., Malacca, 1896.

GARRAWAY, David G., I.S.O. (1906).—Entered the provost-marshal's office, Grenada, in Jan., 1867; ch. elk., col. sec.'s office, 1868; elk. of couns., 1868 to 1878; dep. sec., regir., and elk. of the crown, and sec. bd. of educn., 1871 to 1878; comsnr. of census, 1871; ag. auditor, 1871 to 1872, and 1875; sec. to exec. comtees, 1875-6; ag. treas., 1876-7-9, 1880-1-2; and ex officio a mem. of the legislature; auditor, 1878; notary public, 1880; compiler of census, 1881; ag. pol. mag., St. Vincent, 1883-4; treas., St. Lucia, July, 1884; mem. ex. and leg. couns.; performed duties of col. sec. in conjunction with his own during visit of gov.-in-ch., 1889 and 1896; admstrd. govt., part of Feb., 1899; comp. of customs; Br. Guiana, Sept., 1900; mem. of excise bd.; cent. bd. of hth. and quar. bd., div. pub. offrs. guar. fund.

GARRAWAY, D. Julian.—Entd. pub. serv., St. Lucia, Mar., 1892, as supernumy. clk., treasy.; ag. 4th clk., Nov., 1892; clk. P.O., June, 1893; ag. clk. to adminstr.-in-chief, Windward Is., Aug., 1893; 2nd clk. registr.'s off., June, 1895; ch. clk., Jan., 1898; ag. registr., sheriff and adminstr.-gen., on 3 occasions, 1901-2-3; rev.offr., Grenada, June, 1903; ag. pol. mag., West Dist., Feb., 1904; additional coroner, West Dist., Mar., 1904; ag. pol. mag., North Dist., for spec. purpose of hearing appeals agst. town bd. assessmnts for 1904; asst. tax offr. in connectn. with hearing appeals agst. assessmnts. for land and house taxes for 1904; ag. pol. mag., West Dist., May and June, 1905; ag. comsnr., Carriacou, Aug., Sept., 1906; ag. road surv., West Dist., Oct., 1906, in addition to duties of substantive office.

GARRAWAY, E. C. F., L.R.C.S.I.—Dist. surg., Millwood, Knysna, Cape Colony, 1888; ditto, Kuruman, Brch., 1891; surg., Bech. Bord., pol., 1892; divsln. med. offr., S.A.C., with rank of major, 1901; prin. med. offr., ditto, Mar., 1905; served in Mataele wars and Boer war (1899-1902).

GARRAWAY, R. F.—Postmr., Dominica, June, 1881; sec. bd. of hth. and quar. bd., Sept., 1881; ag. dist. mag., dist. G., Apr., 1893.

GARRETT, Herbert Leonard Offley.—B. 1881; Ed. at Charterhouse and St. John's Coll., Camb.; B.A., 1902 (2nd cls. hons., class. tripods); ast. mast., The Lodge, Barbados, 1903-4; jun. ast. mast., Queen's Coll., Hong Kong, 1904.

GARRETT, Mark.—In F.A.M.P., Cape, July, 1876, to Nov., 1879; clk. to C.C. and R.M. King William's Town, Sept., 1880; clk. col. sec.'s office, Capetown, May, 1884; sec. civ. ser. coman., Mar., 1886; prin. clk., atty.-gen.'s office, 1895; sub-comsnr., war losses compensation comsn., Mar. to Sept., 1903; census staff, col. sec.'s office, prin. clk., pol. branch, atty.-gen.'s office, Aug., 1904.

GARRICK, The Hon. Sir J. F., K.C., K.C.M.G. (1886), C.M.G. (1885).—B. 1836; sec. for public lands and mines, Queensland, 6th Feb., 1878; atty.-gen., Dec., 1878, to Jan., 1879; col. treas. and postmr.-gen., 13th Nov. to Dec., 1883, when he resig. the former office; agt.-gen. for col. in London, June, 1884, to June, 1888; was deleg. to col. confce., 1887; again agt.-gen., 1890-5; d. 1907.

GATT, C.—Supt. govt. printing office, Malta, Feb., 1882; was priv. sec. to Sir Richard Wood, H.M.'s diplomatic agt. and consul-gen., Tunis, Sept., 1868, to May, 1871; ast. sec., Gozo, 1892; rec.-gen., 1899; audr.-gen., 1902; mem. of ex. coun. and of coun. of govt., 1903.

GATT, L., C.M.G. (1901), C.E.—Entered the Malta ser., Mar., 1883, as land survr.; rly. inspr., 1884; ast. engrn., waterwks., 1885; survr. P.W.D., 1888; manager and engrn., Malta rly., 1895; ch. engrn., waterwks., and elect. lighting dept., 1896; supt. of P.W., with a seat in exec. coun., and a seat in coun. of govt., 1897.

GATTY, Sir Stephen Herbert, Kt., Bach. (1904), K.C.—Scholar Winchester schl. and New Coll., Oxon.; called to bar, Mid. Tem., Nov., 1874; went the N.E. circuit; atty.-gen. Lee-ward Islands, June, 1883; ag. ch. justice and local comsnr., W. Ind. incumbered estates ct. for Antigua, June to Oct., 1884; chancellor of the diocese of Antigua, July, 1884; local comsnr. incumbered estates ct. for St. Kitts, Oct., 1884; atty.-gen., Trinidad, Dec., 1885; chancellor of diocese and admntg. advoc., 1887; chmn. roy. comsn. on franchise and electoral dists., 1888, and of royal comsn. on Metayer system in Tobago, 1890; puisne judge, S. Stltns., 1892; chief just., Gibraltar, 1895; resig., Mar., 1905.
GAVIN, J. C.—Sec. to treasy., rec.gen., and paymr.gen., New Zealand, Mar., 1860; asst. comptroller and audr.gen., 1890.

GEAR, HON. HENRY.—M.H.A. for dist. of Burin, Newfoundland, 1900; again elected, 1904; mem. exec. com., 1903.

GEBERS, H. L.—Student Int. S.N.A. Dep., 1894; clk., Zulu and D. Int. mag., ct., Dundee, 1895; 3rd cls. clk., 1895; 2nd cls. clk., 1900; lent to Transvaal, 1901; clk. of ct. P. P. Vryheid, 1901; J.P.; Vryheid, 1901; A. A. M., Vryheid, 1902; reverted to Natal service, 1903; transf'd to mag. ct., Dundee, 1904, senior clk. and A. A. M.

GEBERS, WILHELM FRIEDRICH.—Asst. inspr. of native educ., Natal, 1st Mar., 1903; inspr., ditto, 1st July, 1904; sub-inspr. of schls., 1st July, 1906.

GEIKIE, R.—Ed. at Harrow and Cambridge; undergraduate scholarship, King's Coll., 1895; Winchester prizeman, 1896; 1st class hist. tripos, 1896; elected fellow King's Coll., 1900; app'td. after open compet. exam., 2nd class clk. Local Govt. Bd., Nov., 1897; 2nd class clk., C.O., Mar., 1899.

GEMMELL, GEORGE.—Clk. treasy. dept., Seychelles, Feb., 1887; clk. to admr., Feb., 1889; clk. of councils, Jan., 1897; 1st customs off'r., May, 1900; postmr., June, 1905.

GENNADIUS, P.—Dir. of agricul., Cyprus, 1896.

GEORGE, WM. JAMES, J.P.—Ed. Midland Institute, Birmingham; M.L.A., W. Aust., 1895 to 1902; comsnr. of rlwys., July, 1902.

GIBBES, REGINALD PRESCOTT.—Cadet, S.S., Nov. 1889; passed final exam., Tamil, Jan., 1892; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, Aug. to Nov., 1892; ag. dist. off'r., Nebong Tebal, P. W., Mar., 1894; passed exam. in Malay, 1894; 2nd ast. prot. of imigrts., Penang, May, 1896; ag. dist. off'r., Dindungs, Aug., 1897; transf'd to Calcutta as (temp.) ast. emigtn. agt. for Trinidad, Mauritius, Fiji, Jamaica, &c., Aug., 1900; app't confirmed, Aug., 1901; passed exam. in Hindustan, May, 1901; ag. emigtn. agt., 19th Feb. to 12th Oct., 1902; emigtn. agt., 14th Sept., 1903.

GIBBS, LAWRENCE.—A.M.I.C.E., grad. assoc., and county engrn.; ast. engrn. P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1890; ag. exec. engrn., 1896.

GIBRALTAR, LORD BISHOP OF, RT. REV. WM. ED. COLLINS.—Late Exhib. of Selw. Coll., Camb.; B.A. (Jun. Opt.), 1887; Lightfoot schl., 1889; Prince Consort pri., 1890; M.A., 1891; B.D., 1902; D.D., 1903; F.C. of All Hallow's, Barking, Lond., 1890-1; lectr. of Selw. Coll., 1891-3; lectr. of St. John's Coll., Camb., 1891-4; exam. hist. trip., 1894-5; select jr., Camb., 1899-1902; prof. of eccles. hist., King's Coll., Lond., 1893-1904; C. of All Hallows, Barking, 1894; exam. chap. to Bp. of St. Albans (Festing), 1897-1903; Bishop of Gibraltar, 25th Jan., 1904.

GIBSON, FRED. ALLAN, I.S.O. (1903).—B. 1860; clk. Mauritius civ. ser. after exam., Oct., 1875; clk. despatch branch, Sept., 1878; ag. précis writer, Nov., 1882, to June, 1883; ag. ch. clk. and sec. to exec. and legis. couns., Mar., 1890; clk. exec. and legis. couns., Sept., 1892; ag. jun. ast. col. sec., Sept., 1892; ch. clk., Mar., 1894; ag. ast. col. sec., June, 1894, to Jan., 1895; June to Dec., 1895, Mar. to Sept., 1896, Jan. to Nov., 1897; ag. registr.-gen., Jan. to Sept., 1899; nom. mem. coun. of govt., Apl. to Sept., 1899; ag. ast. col. sec., July, 1900; ast. col. sec., Apr., 1901; collr. of cust., 9th Nov., 1903; ag. col. sec., 9th Nov., 1903, to 19th Aug., 1904; ditto, 19th Sept. to 18th Dec., 1904.

GIBSON, HENRY JAMES, C.B. (1902), B.A.—B. 1869; ed. Rossall and St. John's Coll., Oxford; Casherd scholar; 1st cls. class. mods.; clk. War Office, 1885; princ. clk., 1897; ast. acctnt.-gen., 1900; dep. acctnt.-gen., 1903; ast. dir. of Army finance, 1904; priv. sec. to Mr. Woodall, 1894-95; to Hon. St. John Brodrick, 1895-6; ast. compt. and audr., 1905; is hon. ast. audr. for certain Crown Colonies and Prots., ag. on behalf of the S. of S. for the Colonies

GIBSON, JAS. YOUNG.—Clk. and Zulu interp. to ct. of R.M.; sub-distr. of stamps, and regisr. circuit ct., Newcastle, Natal, Apr., 1882; also dep. clk. of peace, Mar., 1887; ast. comrs. and R.M., Nqutu dist., Zululand, Feb., 1889; ditto, Ndawande dist., May, 1889; mag. for colonv.; mag., Umvoti div., 1900; J.P. for colony, 1902; ag. mast., sup. ct., 1904; mag., Up. Umkomazi, 1904.

GILES, MORTIMER.—Entl. survey dept., S. Australia, 1864; draughtsmen, 1875; clk. and ast. draughtsmen, lands titles off., 1876; draughtsmen, 1889; draughtsmen and 3rd dep. regisr.-gen. of deeds, 1901; regisr.-gen. of deeds and regisr. of buildg. socs., 1904.

GILL, THOMAS, I.S.O. (1903).—B. 1849; entered col. service, S. Australia, Feb., 1865; acctnt., treasy., Jan., 1883; under treas., 1894; also regisr. of inscribed stock in Adelaide, 1895, and mem. of supply and tender bd., 1903.

GILL, WALTER, F.L.S., F.R.H.S.—Conservator of forests, S. Australia, July, 1890.

GILLIGAN, GEOFFREY G.—Capt., 4th Battn. A. and S. Highrs.; served in S. Africa, 1900-01; (medal with 3 clasps); inspr. of pol., Br. Guiana, 1904; ast. polit. offr., Somaliland, Jan., 1906.

GILLOTT, HON. SIR SAMUEL KT. BACH (1901).—B. 1838; M.L.A. for East Melbourne, Victoria, since Feb., 1899; min. without portfolio 1900-01; atty.-gen., 1901-02; Mayor of Melbourne, 1900-02; first Lord Mayor, 1902-3; chief sec. and min. of labour, Victoria, Feb., 1904.

GILMAN, E.W.F., B.A., Oxon. Cadet, S.S., Nov., 1899; ag. 4th magrs., Sing., Nov., 1901; passed final exam. in Tamil, June, 1902; ag. ast. supt. of Indian immigrants, Penang, Apl., 1902; confirmed, July, 1904.

GILMORE, HON. GEORGE CROSLER.—B., 1864; B.A., LL.M.; barrister-at-law, Inner Tem.; barrister, solr., attorney and proctor of Tasmania; M.L.A for George Town, Tasmania, 1893-1900; comsr. of ct. of requests and stip. mag., West Coast, 1900-1903; M.L.A. for Waratah since 1903; atty.-gen. of Tasmania, July, 1904.

GIROUARD, DESIRÉ, K.C.—Ed. Montreal Coll.; called to the bar, Canada, 1860; K.C., 1876; represented Jacques Cartier co., 1878 to 1895; judge sup. ct., Canada, 1895.

GIROUARD, LT.-COL. SIR EDWARD PERCY CRANWILL, K.C.M.G. (1900), D.S.O., R.E.—Served with Dongola expeditionary force, 1896 (desp.), brevet-major; British medal, Khedive's medal, 2 clasps); Nile expdn., 1897 (desp., clasp); rlwy. traff. man., Woolwich Arsenal, 1890-5; dir. of Sudan rlwys., 1896-8; pres. Egyptian rlwy., bd., 1898-9 (2nd cls. Modjide); S. African war, 1899-1902 (desp.); comsnr. of rlwys., Transvaal and O.R.C., 1902; mem. I.C.C.; resig. 1904; high comsnr., N. Nigeria, 1907.

GLASGOW, 7TH EARL OF, THE RIGHT HON. SIR DAVID BOYLE, G.C.M.G. (1892).—B. 1833; capt. (retired) R.N.; served in the Crimean and China wars, 1857 (medal and clasp); J.P. for Avrshire, and chmn. of co. coun.; gov. of N.Z., 1892-97.

GLASIER, F. BEDFORD.—Ast. civ. engrn., Bermuda harbr. wks., June, 1894; engrn.in
charge, Coatracoalcos harbr. wks., Mexico, May, 1896; dist. engrnr., S. Leone govt. rly., June, 1897; dist. engrnr., Tarkwa rly., Gold Coast, Oct. 1898; and gen. manager, S. Leone govt. rly., May, 1899; promoted gen. manager, Lagos govt. rly., Apr., 1900.

GLYDE, ADOLPHUS YEOVIL.—Apptd. clk. in land titles dept., Perth, W. Australia, 1882; dep. regir. of titles, ag. regir. of deeds, sub. collr. of internal rev., asst. regir. of titles, 1893; ag. regir. of deeds, Nov. 1896, to Jan., 1897.

GOBEIL, ANTOINE, I.S.O. (1904).—Law clk., dept. of pub. wks., Canada, 1879 to 1883; then sec., dep. min. of pub. wks., Jan., 1891.

GODBOLT, THOMAS.—Entd. N. S. Wales public serv., July, 1871, as jun. clk., govt. printing off.; asst. paymaster of imperial pensions, 1877; bd. of trade clk. and cashier, govt. shipping office, 1881; emergency offr., col. treas., 1891; paymaster of imperial pensions and allowances, 1893; paymaster, N. S. Wales Imperial Bushmen's contingent (local pay and allowances), 1900, and chief paymaster (for local pay and allowances), N. S. Wales Naval Contingent to China, 1900.

GODFREY, JOSEPH ED.—M.B. and C.M., Edin., 1882; gov. med. offr., B. Guiana, Feb., 1883; med. inspr. of estates hospitals, May, 1898; deputy regir. of births, deaths and marriages, 1898; deputy chmn., cent. bd. of health, 1902; acted on sev. occasions as surg.-gen., regir.-gen., and chmn. of cent. bd. of health; apptd. surg.-gen., regir.-gen. of b., d. and m., chmn. cent. bd. of health, and offl. mem. of ct. of policy, July, 1904.

GODFREY, LEOPOLD HENRY.—Active serv. volunteer in 1st batt., Royal Sussex regt., Feb., 1901, to May, 1902; architectural draughtsmn, pub. wks. dept., O.R.C., June, 1902.

GOLDIE, CHARLES.—Apptd., after compet. exam., an examg. offr., H.M. customs, Greenock, Sept., 1863; inspr. of invoices and ch. landing survr. H.M. customs, Jamaica, Oct., 1869; one of the comsrs. to inquire into the pilot service of Jamaica, Apr., 1870; ag. collr. of customs, Kingston, 1873, and 1875 to 1876; acted in 1874 as island treas., and as collr.-gen. of customs, 1875 and 1885; collr. of customs and shipping master, Kingston, 1883.

GOLDNEY, SIR JOHN TANKERVILLE, Kt. BACH. (1893).—B. 1846; ed. Harrow, and Trin. Coll., Camb.; called to the bar, Inner Tem., 1869, N. circuit; atty.-gen., Leeward Is., Apr., 1880; ag. ch. just., May, 1881; puisne judge, Br. Guiana, June, 1883; judge sup. ct., S. Stltnts., Mar., 1887; ch. just., Trinidad, 1892; retired, 1902.

GOLLAN, H. C.—Ed. at Charterhouse; M.A., Edin. (1887); called to the bar, Mid. Tem., Jan., 1891, N. circuit; priv. sec. to Col. Lugard, comsrr. and comdt., W.A.F.F., Sept. 1st, 1899; priv. sec. to H.C. of Nor. Nig., 1st Jan.-21st Sept., 1900; ag. sec. to the admintr., 1st June-31st Aug., 1900; atty.-gen. of Nor. Nig., 21st Sept., 1900; ag. ch. just., 16th Nov., 1900-4th Apr., 1901; ch. just., 4th Nov., 1901; ch. just., Bermuda, 1904.

GOMPERTZ, H. H. J.—Ed. at Bedford schl. and Exeter Coll., Oxon (scholar); 2nd cl. lit. hum., B.A. (1890); cadet, S. Stltnts., 1890; passed final exam. Chinese, Dec., 1893; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, Aug., 1894, to Dec., 1896; passed final exam. in Cantonese, 1895; agt. deputy-registr., sup. ct., Penang, Dec., 1896; passed final exam. in Hokkien, 1897; 2nd asst. prot. of Chinese, 1st Jan., 1897; transf. to Hong Kong as asst. registr.-gen., 1897; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, Easter, 1899; actg. sen. mag., June, 1899, to June, 1900; asst. col. sec. Jan. 1st, 1900; mem. land ct., 1st June, 1900; pres. land ct. 10th Jan., 1902; ag. pol. mag., 1904-5; ag. sen. mag., June, 1906.

GOODMAN, CLIFFORD E.—Entered pub. library, Barbados, Sept., 1890; 5th clk., audr.-gen.'s office, Apr., 1891; ch. clk., inspr.-gen.'s office, July, 1892; also regir. of births, dist. A.

GOODMAN, GERALD AUBRET.—Ed. at Lodge-schl. and Harrison Coll., Barbados, and Univ. Coll., Lond.; 1st com. law schlr., Mid. Temp., Trinity term, 1885; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., June, 1885; ag. judge of petty debt ct., and of asst. ct. of appeal, Barbados, 1889; J.P., 1889; ag. solr.-gen. in 1890-1-2; M.H.A. since Oct., 1889; mem. bd. of educ. since Oct., 1891; solr.-gen., Mar., 1896; ag. atty.-gen., 1891, 1898, 1900-1-2-3-4; K.C. for Barbados, 1903; mem. of quar. bd. and gen. bd. of health, 1902.

GOODMAN, SIR WILLIAM MEIGH, KT. BACH. (1902).—B. 1847; ed. at Univ. Coll.; graduated B.A. (honours) at the Univ. of Lond., 1867; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., Nov., 1870; went S.E. circ. and Surrey sessions; atty.-gen., Br. Honduras, 1883; ch. just., 1886; comsrr. to revise and consolidate the laws of the col., 1886; atty.-gen. Hong Kong, 1889; ag. col. sec., May, 1891, to Mar., 1892; ag. ch. just., Mar. to Aug., 1895, Jan. to May, 1896, and Apr., 1899, to Feb., 1900; K.C., 1900; ch. just., Hong Kong, 1st April, 1902; ret., 1905.

GOODRIDGE, HON. A. F.—Mem. of house of assem. for Ferryland, Newfoundland, 1880 to 1882, and 1882 to 1885; for Twillingate, 1885 to 1889; returned for same dist., 1893; mem. exec. coun., 1885 (without portfolio) to 1889, and again in 1894; after the resign. of the Whiteway ministry in Apr., 1894, he was called upon to form a ministry, and became premier of the col., which office he held till Dec., 1894; was a mem. of the bd. of wks. and rly. comsrs. under the Thorburn admnstr. (1885-9); he is also a mem. of the Newfoundland chamb. of com., and has been its pres. and vice-pres.

GOOLD, ALBERT WM. FISHER.—Supernum. inspr. of pol., Mauritius, 19th Dec., 1881; inspr., 16th Sept., 1894; ch. offr., 1st Nov., 1898; inspr.-gen., 17th Aug., 1902.

GOOLD-ADAMS, MAJOR SIR H. J., K.C.M.G. (1902), C.B. (1898), C.M.G. (1894).—B. 1858; Roy. Scots fus.; comdg. a troop Bechuanaland border police, Aug., 1885; comdt., 1888; major, 1889; again comdt., 1893-5; commanded field force against Matabele, 1893; res. comsrr. for Bechuanaland Protectorate; dep. admnr., Orange River Col., Jan., 1901; lt.-gov., 7th Aug., 1901.

GORDON, ARTHUR HENRY WYNNDHAM.—Supt. of police, Mauritius, 28th Nov., 1889; ag. inspr.-gen., 2nd Aug., 1892; supt. of prisons and reformatory, 25th Oct., 1892.

GORDON, ARTHUR JOHN LEWIS, C.M.G. (1877).—B. 1847; priv. sec. to the gov. of Trinidad, 1866 to 1870; ag. col. sec., Trinidad, Apr., 1870; priv. sec. to gov. of Mauritius, 1870; priv. sec. to the gov. of Fiji, 1875-80; priv. sec. to gov.-gen. of Canada (Earl of Aberdeen), 1893.

GORDON, J. G. W.—Ed. at King Edward's Schl., Birmingham; attached to headcrs. staff, Natal Army, South African War (Queen's medal and six clasps, King's medal); cont., stationery dept., O.R.C., 17th Nov., 1900.

GORDON, BRIG.-GEN., J.M., C.B. (1901).—B. 1856; Lieut. R.A., from the R.M. Acad., Woolwich, 1875; lieut. instr. R.V. force,
S. Australia, Dec., 1881; on the formation of a permanent artillery force in S. Australia, apptd. lieut.-in-comd., Sept., 1882; capt., Aug., 1883; maj., May, 1885; ag. D.A.A.G., Dec., 1885; and hon. A.D.C., May, 1886; comdt. S. Australia mil. forces, 1893; lieut.-col., 1892; col., 1895; brig.-gen., 1901; inspr. mil. stores for Australian cols., 1898-9; transf'd, with mil. def. dept., to serv. of Commonwealth of Aust., 1st Mar., 1901.

GORDON, JAMES.—Admitted to S. Aust. bar, 1881; stip. mag., Adelaide, 1892; pol. mag., Adelaide, 1902; mem. of Adelaide licensing bench, 1892; chrmn. ditto, 1901; mem. central bd. of health, 1901.

GORDON, THE HON JOHN HANNAH, K.C.—Admitted to S. Aust. bar, 1876; M.L.C., 1888; min. of ed., 1889-90 and 1892; ch. sec., 1893-6; atty.-gen., 1899-1902; atty.-gen. and min. of ed., 1902-3; 3rd judge of sup. ct., 1903.

GORDON, RICHARD WOLF.—Clk. in supreme ct., England, 1892; 3rd asst., B.C. Africa Prot., Apr., 1900; ag. collr., Angoniland, 1904; 2nd cls. dis. res., Apr., 1906.

GORDON, WILLIAM MONTGOMERIE.—Ed. Edin. Acad.; clk. to consul-gen. of W. Pacific, Aug., 1879; clk. of exec. coun. and ch. clk. of crown lands in col. of Fiji, May, 1880; also acted as sec. to lands comm.; res. commr. and stip. mag. for the island of Rotumah, May, 1882; commr. to inquire into claims of Europeans to land, Nov., 1882; stip. mag., Fiji, Apr., 1889; priv. sec. to gov., Ceylon, June, 1887; ch. clk. col. secy.'s off., Leewards and clk. of fed., exec. and legis. couns., and of the local legis. coun. of Antigua, Apr., 1889; ag. commr., Montserrat, Dec., 1891, to Mar., 1892, Mar., 1894, to June, 1895, and July to Dec., 1899; ag. col. sec., Leeward Islds., Aug. to Nov., 1900; asst. col. sec., Trinidad, July, 1901; ag. col. sec., Trinidad, Aug.-Sept., 1903, Mar.-Aug., 1904, Apr.-Sept., 1905; admstl. govt., 25th-28th Aug., 1905.

GOBE, LIEUT.-COL. JAMES C.—Audit.-gen. W. Africa Sttlmnts. from 1882 to 1887; apptd. to admstl. govt. of the Gambia, June to Nov., 1894; col. sec. S. Leone, 1894; rec.-gen., Cyprus, 1901.

GORMANSTON (14th VISCOUNT) (created 1478), and BARON GORMANSTON, United Kingdom, 1868, JENICO WILLIAM JOSEPH PRESTON, G.C.M.G. (1897), K.C.M.G. (1887).—B. 1837; has been chamberlain to the lord-lieut. of Ireland, and a commr. of national educn., and dep. lieut.-col., Dublin; served in the 60th rifles during the Indian Mutiny (medal); gov.-in-ch., Leeward Is., 1885; of Br. Guiana, 1887; of Tasmania, 1893 to 1900.

GOTTLIEB, F. H. VALENTINE.—Entered gov't. service, S. Sttlmnts., Oct., 1880; ch. clk. G.P.O., Singapore, 1888; called to the bar, Mid. Tem., 1892; dep. regis. sup. ct., Singapore, Aug., 1895; ag. asst. regis. sup. ct. and mag., Macceca, Mar., 1898; also ag. sheriff, Sep., 1898, to Nov., 1899; asst. regis., sup. ct., Penang, July, 1904.

GOUGE, HERBERT DILLON.—Assessor, land tax dept., S. Australia, Apr., 1886; pub. actuary, Mar., 1894.

GOUGH, FREDERIC HARRISON.—Ed. at Oriel Coll., Oxford; 2nd cls. class. mods., 1884; B.A. (2nd cls. final class. sch.), 1886; M.A., 1889; barrister-at-law, Inner Tem., 1894; N.E. Circuit; pol. mag. and coroner, Freetown, S. Leone, July, 1903; solr.-gen., Oct., 1903; ag. atty.-gen. on various occasions, 1903-1906.

GOUGH, FREDERIC.—Messenger in office of Woods and Forests, 12th Apr., 1869; apptd., after exam., mess. C.O., 20th Jan., 1871; Queen's mess., Mar., 1880; sent three times on foreign service; acted as Queen's page-in-waiting on col. premiers during diam. jub., 1897; read. address of thanks, and jub. medal, 1897; res. off. keeper, C.O., Mar., 1898; apptd. by the S. of S. to be in attendance on col. premiers during their Coronation visit, 1902; (received joint letter of thanks, and Coronation medal).

GOULBURN, BISHOP OF, RIGHT REV. CHRISTOPHER GEORGE BARLOW.—D.D., 1891; ordained by Bishop of N. Queensland, 1881; curate of Mackay, 1881-2; vicar of St. Paul's, Charters Towers, 1882-5; mission chaplain to the bishop, 1885-6; vicar of St. James's pro-cathedral, Townsville, 1886-91; hon. canon, 1887-91; vicar-gen. 1887-8; consecrated 2nd bishop of N. Queensland, 1889; installed Bishop of Goulburn, 23rd Apr., 1902.

GOULD, JULIAN BARING.—Cadet, Sarawak serv., Mar. 1897; asst. res., Nov., 1900; res., 2nd cls., Jan., 1902.

GOURDEAU DE BEAULIEU, MAJOR FRANCOIS FRÉDÉRIC.—Priv. sec. to Hon. J. Cauchon; mem. of Mackenzie admin., 1870; ch. clk. and acctnt. dept. of marine and fisheries; dep. min. of marine and fisheries of Canada, May, 1896.

GOWAN, SIR JAMES ROBERT, K.C.M.G. (1905), C.M.G. (1893), LL.D.—B. 1815; lieut., 4th regt., North York, 1838; called to Canadian bar, 1839; judge of Simcoe, 1842-83; chairman of bd. of pub. instruction, 1844 to 1871; commr. for consolidating statute law of Canada, 1858-59; chmn. of bd. of judges, 1869-86; engaged in consolidation of the crim. law for Dominion, 1869; mem. of "The Law Reform Comm." 1871; roy. commr. to inquire into charges against the ministry in reference to the Pacific rly. contract, 1873; commr. for consolidating the statutes of Ontario, 1876-77; apptd. to high ct. of just., 1882; a senator of the Dominion, 1885; clmm. of Barrie Collegiate Inst., by annual election, 1881-87; called to Irish bar, 1889.

GOWDEY, WM. WALLACE.—Solr., Barbados, 1881; mem. house of assessees, 1883-93; mem. of comte of inquiry into Dodd's reformatory and industrial schl., 1884; mem. bd. of health, 1884-92; J.P., 1885; mem. of financial inquiry comm., 1885; of general hosp. bd., 1889-92; pol. mag. and judge petty debt ct., Dist. E., Barbados, 1892; receiver of wrecks, Dist. E., July, 1897; pol. mag., Dist. A. Oct., 1901; visiting just., Lazaretto, Jan., 1902; receiver of wrecks, Dist. A., May, 1902; ag. judge, Bridgetown petty debt ct., May and June, 1902; ag. judge, asst. ct. of appeal, July, 1902, to Feb., 1903; commr. of probates, Aug., 1902; judge, Bridgetown petty debt ct., Dec., 1902; ag. coroner, Dist. A., March to May, 1903; ag. judge, asst. ct. of appeal, April, 1903; ag. inspr. of prisons, May, 1903.

GRAHAM, MICHAEL, M.R.C.S., Eng., L.R.C.P. Lond., M.A., M.B., B.C., Camb., 1891.—Ed. St. John's Coll., Camb.; St Thomas's Hosp., Lon.; B.A. Camb., 1887; 1st cl. honours nat. sciences, tripus and exhibitioner, St. John's Coll.; asst. med. offr., city asylum, Birmingham, 1891; surg. to the lying-in hospital and general penitentiary, Kingston, Jamaica, 1892; late sec. med. council of Jamaica, 1897; mem. bd. of governors, Institute of Jamaica, 1902; joint author, with F. V. Theobald, S.E. Agric. Coll., "A Monograph on the Mosquitoes of Jamaica," 1905.

GRAHAM, SIR FREDK., K.C.B. (1907), C.B. (1899).—B. 1848; apptd. clk. in the office of the sec. of state for the cols., after compet. exam., 30th May,
1870; 2nd class clk., 30th Sept., 1872; priv. sec. to Mr. Herbert, 1st Oct., 1872; to the Rt. Hon. M. E. Grant-Duff, M.P., 8th Jan., 1881, to 5th Aug., 1881; to Mr. L. H. Courtney, M.P., 6th Aug., 1881; to the Hon. Evelyn Ashley, 12th May, 1882; and to the Earl of Dunraven, 24th June, 1885; to Sir R. Herbert, 3rd Feb., 1886; and again to the Earl of Dunraven, 3rd Aug., 1886, to Feb., 1887; 1st class clk., Dec., 1887; ag. prin. clk., Feb., 1892; prin. clk., 11th Mar., 1896; asst. under sec. of state, 1st Mar., 1897; ret., 1907.

GRAHAM, SIR JOHN JAMES, K.C.M.G. (1905), C.M.G. (1899).—B. 1847; clk. to C.C. and R.M., Albany, 1864; clk. to regis. E. dists. ct., May, 1865; asst. regisr., Jan., 1868; asst. regisr. sup. ct., Mar., 1872; regisr. and master, E. dists. ct., Feb., 1875; ch. clk. to atty-gen. and clk. of peace, Capetown, Jan., 1878; sec. law dept., July, 1882; high sheriff and taxing offr., sup. ct., May, 1884; mem. of the col. tender bd.; a J.P. for the col.; sec. to law dept., 1889.

GRAINGER, HENRY ALLERDALE.—Mem. H. of Ass. S. Austr., 1884, 1890 and 1901; state agent in London for S. Austr., 1901; ag.-gen., 1902-1905.

GRANGE, HERBERT CHARLES.—Apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. serv., and assigned to bd. of educ., Aug., 1901; transfd. to C.O., Feb., 1902.

GRANNUM, CLIFTON.—Ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados; 2nd clk. to gov. Windward Is., Sept., 1891; ditto St. Vincent, Apr. 1892; supervisor of customs, G. Coast Coll., Oct., 1893; asst. local audr., G. Coast and Lagos, May, 1895; local audr., S. Leone, June, 1896; J.P., S. Leone, 1897; ch. asst. treas., G. Coast, Apl., 1903; ag. treas. and mem. ex. and leg. couns., mem. bd. of educ., July, 1903-June, 1904.

GRANNUM, EDWARD ALLAN.—Passed Barbados, W. I., civ. ser. exam., 1886; 3rd clk. regi-strar's off., Jan. to Oct., 1885; 2nd clk., Oct., 1885, to Nov., 1887; clk. master in chancery off., Nov., 1887, to June, 1888; honours graduate, diploma Ontario Com. Coll., Canada, affiliated institute chartered accountants, Canada, Dec., 1889; practised public accountant, Barbados, W. I., to Aug., 1897; asst. auditor, Sierra Leone and Gambia, 25th Sept., 1897, to 15th Jan., 1900; acted auditor May to Nov., 1898 asst. auditor, Gold Coast and Lagos, Jan. to March, 1900; auditor, March, 1900; introduced system double entry accounts Gold Coast P.O., July, 1901; prepared scheme for introduction of double entry system of accounts for Accra town council, Aug., 1901.

GRANNUM, EDWARD T.—Representative of Bridgetown, Barbados Assem., 1883; J.P., 1886; mem. exec. comtee., 1885-89, and 1890-94; mem. gen. bd. of health, 1885; deleg. to Washington as to tariff arrangements under McKinley act, 1891; audr.-gen., Barbados, 1894; ag. col. sec. and mem. exec. coun., Aug. to Dec., 1895, and July to Nov., 1896; ag. col. sec., mem. of exec. coun., May to Sept., 1897, also in 1905, and June to Sept., 1906.

GRANT, CHARLES CAMERON.—King's student, Aberdeen Univ., 1879-8; M.A., ditto, 1899; 2nd asst., Fraserburgh pub. schl., Aberdeenshire, 1890-1901; 1st asst., Aberlour pub. schl., Banffshire, 1901-2; priv. coun. certif., Scotch educn. dept., 1901; teacher, refugee camp, Springfontein, O.R.C., Nov., 1902; priv., govt. schl., Winburg, Jan., 1903; corrprnde. clk., educn. dept., Sept., 1904; admstve. clk., 1905; sec., Grey Coll. coun., 1906.

GRANT, COLIN.—Apptd. 3rd asst., Br. Cent. Africa Prot., 1897; 2nd cls. dist. res., Oct., 1905.

GRANT, H. E. W.—Sec. to the educn. bd., Barbados, 1882; priv. sec. to Sir W. Robinson, 1883; and at Trinidad, 1885 to 1891; went on mission to Venezuela, 1887; sec. to special pub. wks. and road loan bd., Trinidad, 1890-1; priv. sec. to Sir W. B. Griffith, gov. of G. Coast, 1891-2; called to the bar, Inner Tem., Jan., 1896 res. just., Harbour Is., Bahamas, Apr., 1897; ag. clk. col. sec.'s office, and ag. clk. of councils, Br. Honduras, Nov., 1899; appt. confirmed, 1901; ag.-atty.-gen., B. Hond., Mar., 1902, to Oct., 1903; ag. col. sec., 14th Dec., 1904, to 21st July, 1905; admstvl. govt., 22nd July to 6th Aug., 1905; ag. col. sec., 7th Aug. to 9th Nov., 1905; col. sec., Falklands, 16th Nov., 1905; assumed office, 14th Feb., 1906.

GRAVES, F. HELY-HUTCHINSON.—Cadet, H.M.S. "Conway," 1889; clk., Imperial Ottoman Bank, Alexandria, 1894; clk., crown agent's off., 1899; acctnt., P.W.D., Northern Nigeria, 1905.

GRAVES, THE HON. J. H.—M.L.A. for Delatite, Victoria; consnr. of trade and customs, Victoria, 9th July, 1881, to Mar., 1883.

GRAVES, SILAS.—Clk., procureur-genrl.'s dept., Mauritius, 2nd May, 1859; deputy collr. of cust., 2nd Mar., 1896; ag. collr. in 1899, 1900, 1903 and 1905.

GRAY, E. A. S.—Denny, Magd. Coll., Oxon; B.A. 1892; asst. mast., Queen's Coll., Br. Guiana, Jan., 1896; asst. dist. commr., Niger Coast prot., Sept., 1899; dist. commr., Feb., 1902.

GRAY, GEORGE SMITH BOOTH ERSKINE.—Conway, 1879-80; midshipman, R.N.R., Dec., 1880; mercantile marine offr., 1894 to 1894; sub-lieut., R.N.R., 1887-1894; Lieut., R.N.R., 1894; H.M.S. "Anson" and naval employment, 1894-1897; joined So. Nigeria marine, Jan., 1900; served Ubium expdn. and Aro campaign (medal); gov. of gaols, 1902.

GRAY, JOHN.—Served during S. African campaign as offr. comdg. cyclist corps, and staff offr. to Col. Barker's force; prin., E. London refugee camp schl., June, 1902; asst. sup't., Brandport refugee camp, July, 1902; sup't., ditto, Sept., 1902; prin., Hoopstad schl., June, 1903; corrprnde.clk., educn. dept., Mar., 1904; statistics clk., ditto, Sept., 1904.

GRAY, REGINALD.—Called to the bar, Inner Tem., 1875; compiled Bermuda laws, 1690-1883, in 1884; revising offr., Bermuda, 1889-93; counsel to statute law consolidation comtee., Bermuda, 1898-1900; atty.-gen., 1900.

GRAY, ST. GEORGE.—B.A., M.B., B.Ch. (Univ. Dub.), L.M. (Rotunda); ag. col. ass't surg., St. Lucia, 1892; supernumerary ditto, 1894; col. ass't surg. and med. offr. in charge of Yaws hosp., 1898; med. offr. in charge of agric. schl., 1901; med. offr., W. Africa med. staff, Sierra Leone, 1903.

GRAY, SIR S. BROWNLLOW, KT. BACH. (1901), C.M.G. (1888).—B. 1823; called to the bar at Lincoln's Inn, 1847; inspr. of schls., Bermuda, 1848; atty.-gen. and advoc.-gen., 1861; ch. justice, May, 1900, ret., 1904.

GRAY, THOS. ALEXANDER.—Served in R.I.C., June, 1882, to Jan., 1899; sergt.-major, Leeward Is. pol. and jailer, Montserrat, Jan., 1899; mem. of hurricane distress relief comtee., and survr. of roads, Northern dist., 1900; inspr. of pol., Dominica, Feb., 1902; J.P. and mem. of telephone bd., Dominica, May, 1902; lieut., Roseau volr. fire brigade, July, 1903; ag. sub-inspr. of schls., Dominica, June to Nov., 1903, and again from
Apr. to Oct., 1904; mil. instr., Dominica defence reserve, 1st Apr., 1904; mem. of Roseau town bd., Jan., 1906; dep. supt. of jail at Mombasa, Br. E. Africa, Jan., 1907.

GREAVES, DUDLEY, A., M.R.C.S., Edin., L.R.C.P., Edin.—Asst. med. offr., Virgin Is., March, 1901; deputy cornh.

GREAVES, Lieut.-Gen. Sir GEORGE RICHARD, K.C.B. (1885), K.C.M.G. (1881), C.B.—B. 1831; has held several important posts; ch. sec. to gov't in Cyprus, July, 1878, to July, 1879; adjt.-gen. in India, Oct., 1879, to Oct., 1884; ch. of the staff at Suakin, 1885; in command of Meerut div. of Indian army to 1892.

GREAVES, KENNETH J.—Ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados; called to bar, Mid. Temple, 26th Jan., 1900; ag. deputy clk., house of assem., Barbados, May-Sept., 1900; ag. pol. mag., Bridgetown, Oct., 1900, to Feb., 1901; ditto, April, 1901; ditto, St. Thomas and St. James, Nov., 1901, to Aug. 1902; apptd. pol. mag., 1st Sept., 1902.

GREAVES, WILLIAM HERBERT, K.C.—B.A., Oxon, honours, juris., 1879; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., 1880; ag. solr.-gen., Barbados, Aug., 1884, to July, 1886, and July, 1886, to Jan., 1887, when confirmed; J.P., Sept., 1886; escheator-gen., 1887; Q.C. for Barbados, 1890; mem. exec. comn., 1890; acted as atty.-gen., July to Dec., 1887, and June to Dec., 1891; mem. of house of assem. since 1882, and of bd. of educn.; atty.-gen., Mar., 1896; now ch. just.

GREEN, AMAZIAH.—Entd. audit dept., N.S. Wales, 1877; regis. of adjustments, audit dept., for two years; bookkeeper, post and telegraph dept., for eight years; acctnt., dept. of justice, 1887; senior inspr., treasy. dept., 1896; military staff paymr., 1900; Comwlth. pub. serv. inspr. for W. Australia, 1902; is also comwlth. electoral offr., and registr. for comwlth. pub. wks., for W. Australia; J.P. for W. Australia and N.S.Wales.

GREEN, A. PIERCE—Surg., A.M.D., 1878; med. offr., col. forces in Basuto war, 1881; regtl. surg., left wing, C.M.R., 1881-4; med. offr., Cape rlys., 1888; ditto, Bechuana land border pol., 1886.

GREEN, CHARLES FRANCIS J.—Cadet, Sts. Sttlmts., Nov., 1898; ag. dist. offr., Prov. Wellesley, Mar., 1900; ag. 4th mag., Sing., June, 1901; passed final exam. in Malay, Oct., 1901; ag. dist. offr., Malacca, Feb., 1902; confirmed, July, 1903; ag. 2nd mag., Sing., July, 1906.

GREEN, GEORGE C.—Apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civil serv., and assigned to C.O., 26th Aug., 1901.

GREEN, JOHN FREDERICK NORMAN, B.A.—Scholar, Emman. Coll., Camb., 1890; bracketed 15th wrangler, 1893; B.A., 1893; 1st class, Part II, nat. science tripus, 1894; 2nd class clk. C.O. after compet. exam., Feb., 1896; priv. sec. to Sir E. Wingfield, Dec., 1898; to Sir M. Ommanney, 1900; 1st class clk., 16th June, 1902.

GREENE, GEOFFREY PHILIP.—Gen. mag. Ceylon rlyws., 11th Oct., 1901.

GREENE, GEORGE BALL.—Ed. in England; jun. clk., id. dept., Br. Guiana, Nov., 1887; 5th class clk., Feb., 1888; 4th cl., secretariat, 1891; sec. to comte. for inquiring into post-office, 1893; sec. pilotage comsn., and 3rd class, 1895; 2nd class, and despatch clk., 1899; 1st class clk., 1901; ag. prin. clk., 1902-4 and 1906; priv. sec. to gov. and ag. gov., 1905 and 1906.

GREENE, JOHN LE SUEUR.—Ed. Roy. Coll.; entered col. sec. office, Mauritius, Jan., 1886; jun. copyist, procur.-gen.'s office, Mar., 1887; sen. ditto, Feb., 1888; govt. translator of laws, Nov., 1888; 5th class clk., July, 1890; 4th class clk., Mar., 1896.

GREENE, SIR WILLIAM CONYNGHAM, K.C.B. (1900), C.B. (1897)—B. 1854; ed. Harrow, and Pemb. Coll., Ox.; M.A. 1890; entrd. F.O. 1877; ag. 3rd sec. legation at Athens, 1890; ditto Stuttgart, 1883; ag. chargé d'affaires Stuttgart and Darmstadt at various times, 1883-9; 2nd sec. diplomatic service, 1887; 2nd sec. Hague, 1889-91; Brussels, 1891-3; sec. of legation and chargé d'affaires, Teheran, 1893-6; H.M. agt. at Pretoria, S.A. Republic, with rank of chargé d'affaires, 25th Aug., 1896, to 1899.

GREENE, W. H., M.I.C.E. (London.)—Asst. engrn., Victorian rlyws., 1885; dist. engrn., 1885; res. engrn., 1868; ch. engrn. of existing lines, 1882; Victorian rly. comsnr., 1887-92.

GREENER, HERBERT.—D.S.O., clk., sec.'s dept., G.P.O., Cape, 1884; in charge of money order dept., 1886; 1st clk., admstr.'s office, B. Bechuana land, 1888; recvr. of revenue, Vryburg, and P.M.G., Bechuana land, 1889; examnr. of acctns., acctnt. to high comsnr., Cape-town, 1890; paymr. (rank captain), Bech. Br. pol., 1891, combined with prin. cust. offr., for Bech. Prot., 1895; specially employed in charge of finances, Mafeking siege, and financial asst. to mil.-govr., Bloemfontein, 1899-1900; transf'd. to S.A.C. as ch. paymr. and acctnt.-gen. (rank major), Oct., 1900; promoted lt.-col., 1901.

GREENLEES, THOMAS DUNCAN, M.B. Edin.—Surg.-capt., Graham's Town 1st city volrs.; late asst. med. offr., counties asyl., Carlisle, and City of London asyl.; prizeman medico-psychological assn.; med. supt., Graham's Town asyl., and visiting surg. to the chronic sick hospital, Aug., 1890.

GREENWAY, THE HON. THOMAS.—Mem. of legis. assem., Manitoba; formerly pres. of exec. comn.; premier; min. of agric. and immigr. and rly. comsnr.

GREENWOOD, ALFRED CRAVEN.—Exec. staff, inventions exhibn., 1885, and Col. and Ind. exhibn., 1886, and Royal Jubilee exhibn., Manchester, 1887; sec. to various charitable instittns., 1887 to 1890; priv. sec. to Sir A. Shea, gov't Bahamas, and clk. to counr., 1891-4; treas. of Gibraltar, 1897; J.P. and mem. of sanitary comsn., chrmn. at various times, 1898-1904, also contractg. offr., 1897; ag. capt. of port, July to Oct., 1901-1903; hosp. comsnr., 1903; chrmn. of comte. on wharfage tolls and storage waterfront wharf, 1902; chrmn. of comte. on management, working and revenue of new comml. mole, 1904.

GREENWOOD, THOMAS J.—Inspr. Cyprus pol., Feb., 1887; ag. local comdt., Limasol, Oct. to Dec., 1894, and Apr. to July, 1895, bronze medal, roy. hum. soc., for saving and attempting to save life during Limasol floods, Nov. 12th, 1894; locl. comdt., 1896.

GREGOROWSKI, REGINALD ADDINGTON.—2nd clk., govt. sec.'s office, O.F.S. Dec., 1895; priv. sec. to state pres., 5th Mar., 1896; landdrost clk., Bethlehem, Dec., 1897; priv. sec. to state pres., July, 1898; landdrost clk., Wepener, Jan., 1899; priv., govt. schl., Reddersburg, O.R.C., Ist Oct., 1900; asst. clk., educn. dept., 1st Mar., 1901; ch. clk. and registr., educn. dept., 1st July, 1901.

GREGORY, HON. HENRY.—B. 1860; M.L.A. for N. Coolgardie, W. Australia, 1897; ditto for Menzies since 1901; min. for mines, 1901-2, and 1902-4; min. for mines and rlyws., Aug., 1905.

GRENFELL, 1ST BARON OF KILVEY (creat. 1902), GENERAL SIR FRANCIS WALLACE, G.C.B., G.C.M.G. (1892).—B. 1841; gov't and comdr-in-chief of Malta, 1898; A.D.C. to Sir A. Cunynghame; also staff offr. to Col. Glyn in the Transkei,
1887-8; dep. asst. adjt. and qrtmr.-gen. in the Kaffir war, 1878; the same in the Zulu war, 1879; asst. qrtmr.-gen. in the Boer war, 1881; served in the Egyptian campaign of 1882, and the Nile expdn. of 1884; was Sirdar of the Egyptian army from 1885 to 1892; commanded the troops employed at Sukam against the Dervishes; after filling various posts at home, went again to Egypt in 1897 to command the British troops; with Lord Kitchener in the Nile campaign, 1898; gov. of Malta, 1899 to 1903; commd. 4th Army Corps, 1903-4; G.O.C. forces in Ireland, 1904.

GRENIER, GEORGE.—Employed in Jaffra Kachcheri and registn. dept., 1861-1872; in Queen's advocate's dept., April, 1872, to 1878; second dep. registr. sup. ct., 9th Apr., 1878; dep. registr., 15th June, 1883; registr., 1st May, 1894.

GRENIER, JOSEPH.—Dist. judge, Colombo, Ceylon, 23rd April, 1903; has acted on various occasions since 1897 as sol.-gen., comsnr. of assize, and puisne justice.

GREY, 4TH EARL OF (creat. 1806), VISCOUNT HOWICK, BARON GREY, BART.—G.C.M.G. (1904), Ed. Harrow, and Trin. Coll., Camb.; M.P., 1880-6; dir. B.S.A. Co.; admstr. of Rhodesia, 1896 to 1898; gov.-gen. of Canada, 26th Sept., 1904.

GREY, ROBERT, CAMBELL.—Junior offr. treas., Selangor, 1st Aug., 1888; asst. in land off., Krian, 14th June, 1889; passed final exam. in Malay, 6th Dec., 1890; asst. mag., Kinta, 24th Dec., 1890; ag. supt. of Penghulus, Lower Perak, 14th June, 1891; supt. ditto, 1st Nov., 1891; asst. mag. and collr. of land rev., Lower Perak, 1st Apr., 1893; ag. dist. mag., Kuala Kangsar, 1st Jan., 1894; asst. sec. to govt., Selangor, 28th Feb., 1895; ag. dist. mag., Krian, 9th Apr., 1896; dist. offr., Ulun Selangor, 1st May, 1897; ditto, Kuala Selangor, 1st Jan., 1899; ditto, Ulu Pahang, 1st Nov., 1899; dist. mag., Kuala Kangsar, 19th Jan., 1900; ag. sec. to govt., Selangor, 1st Oct. to 30th Dec., 1900; ag. dist. mag., Kinta, 10th Oct., 1901; resumed duties as dist. mag., Kuala Kangsar, 21st Nov., 1901; sec. to res., Selangor, 1903.

GREY-WILSON, SIR WM., K.C.M.G. (1904), C.M.G. (1891).—B. 1852; ed. at Chelt. Coll.; priv. sec. to Sir William Grey, gov. of Jamaica, 1874; to Lieut.-Gov. Edw. E. Rushworth, Mar., 1877; admstr., Major-Gen. J. R. Mann, R.E., Aug., 1877; to Lieut.-Gov. F. P. Barlee, Br. Honduras, Sept., 1877; and clk. of the exec. and legis. couns., June, 1878; ag. mag., Orange Walk, in charge of frontier scouts, Dec., 1879, to Apr., 1880, and June, 1880, to Mar., 1881; asst. col. sec. and treas., S. Leone, 1883; special comsnr., Sulymah, Dec., 1883, to June, 1884; 4th asst. col. sec., G. Coast Col., 1884; col. sec., St. Helena, July, 1886; ag. gov., 1887; gov., 1890; gov., Falklands, 1897; gov., Bahamas, 5th May, 1904.

GRIFFIN, CHAS. JAMES.—B.A. (Hons.) Royal Univ., Ireland; 1st schlr. in mod. liter.; triple exhibnr.; chancellor's gold medallist; called to the bar, Ireland, June, 1898; apptd. crn. prosr., B. Cent. Africa Prot., Aug., 1901; ag. chief judicial offr., and H.B.M. vice-consul, Nov., 1901 to June, 1902; ag. judge of high ct., Feb. to Oct., 1904; apptd. registr.-gen.of births, deaths, marriages, and banking, under various local ordinances, and is also registr. of deeds and admstr. of deceased estates under the high ct., judge of high ct., B.C. Africa, 17th Feb., 1906.

GRIFFIN, C. T.—M.R.C.S., Eng.; L.R.C.P., Edin.; L.S.A., Lond.; suptgd. med. offr., Dikoya, Ceylon, 1st Jan., 1883; dist. med. offr., 17th Jan., 1888; govt. med. offr., 1st Sept., 1892; col. surg., prov. of Uva, 21st Sept., 1898; asst. prin. civ. med. offr. and insp.-gen. of hospitals, 17th Jan., 1901.

GRIFFIN, EUGENE PATRICK.—Third clk., treas., Gibraltar (after compet. exam.), Feb., 1883; pol. clk., 1883; 3rd clk., col. sec.'s office, 1886; 2nd class clk., Jan., 1890; 1st class clk., Jan., 1893; ch. clk. and cashier, P.O., Nov., 1893; transf'd. to col. sec.'s office, July, 1895.

GRIFFIN, MARTIN J.—Called to the bar in 1868 from offices of Hon. James McDonald (now ch. just. of Nova Scotia) and of Hon. Wm. Miller (speaker of Senate of Canada); edited Halifax "Express" till 1874; contested Halifax co. for local legislature in 1874; edited Halifax "Herald" till 1878; apptd. asst. on fishery comsn. under Washington Treaty in 1873; priv. sec. to min. of just. in 1878; sec. of civ. serv. comsn. in 1881; edited Toronto "Mail" till Aug. 6, 1885; when apptd. joint partly. librarian.

GRIFFIN, REGINALD HERBERT.—Ed. Marlborough and C. C. Coll., Oxford; 1st mods., 1892; 2nd lit. hum., 1901; clk., higher div. W. O., Oct., 1901; 2nd cls. clk., C. O., Feb., 1903.

GRIFFITH, CHARLES DUNCAN, C.M.G. (1877).—B. 1830; was lieut. Uitenhage Hottentot levy in Kaffir war of 1846-47; lieut. Kaffir pol., Jan., 1848, to Dec., 1850; capt. commanding the Albany Hottentot levy in Kaffir war of 1851-52 (medal); several times mentioned in gen. orders; comdt. of the 2nd div. of the armed mounted pol. force, Nov., 1852; 2nd in command during the operations in 1857-58 against the Tembo chief Fadana, and the Galeka chief Kreli; captured the chief Fadana; C.C. and R.M., Albert, 1858; Queenstown, June, 1859; Albany, Nov., 1868; King William's Town, July, 1869; gov.'s agt. and ch. mag., Br. Basutoland, July, 1871; comdt. of the F.A.M.P. upon the outbreak of the Galeka tribe under the chief Kreli, Sept., 1877; Jan., 1878, comdt.-gen. of col. forces, and from that date in command of the col. forces in the col. until the end of the Galeka war and Gaika rebellion; in July, 1878, received thanks of houses of parlmt. for his services; Aug., 1878, re-apptd. gov.'s agt., in, and ch. mag. for, Br. Basutoland; ret. 1882.

GRIFFITH, F.W.—Matric. Lond. Univ., 1885; supernum. P.O. St. Vincent, Sept., 1885; elk. P.O., Jan., 1886; clk. to col. registr., June, 1886; ag. clk. to registr. sup. ct., Jan., 1887; marshal V.-A.-ct., Nov., 1887; ag. registr. sup. ct., 1888; 2nd clk. govt. office, Apr., 1889; ag. col. postmr., Nov., 1889, to Oct., 1890, Dec., 1891, to Jan., 1892, and May to June, 1892; escheator-gen. and casual revenue, Nov., 1890; inspr. of schls., Dec., 1890; ch. clk. govt. office and clk. of couns., June, 1893; J.P., Apr., 1894; filled combined offices of inspr. of schls. and local audit clk., Jan.-Dec., 1897; med. registr., Jan., 1898; spec. ment. in desps. and commended by S. of S. for services rendered in connection with hurricane relief work, 1898; sec. of hurricane loan bd., June, 1899; mag. 3rd dist. and mag. 1st dist. (crim. jurisdn.), Oct.-Nov., 1899; has acted as mag. and coroner, 1st dist., on several occasions; offl. visitor and visiting just., Kingstown prison, June, 1900; nominated offl. mem., Kingstown bd., 30th June, 1900; acted as regir., sup. ct., and registr.-gen. for short period; sec. to hosp. and asylums inquiry comsn., 1900; performed duties of warden, Leeward dist., Nov., 1900, to Feb., 1901, and July-Aug., 1901; supvr. of cust. and port offr., Apr.-May, 1901; supt. of Crown lands, land comsnr.,
and in charge of survey dept., May, 1903, to Jan., 1904; chmn. of Kingstown bd., Jan., 1904; chief of pol., chief of excise, supt. of pris., port offr., supvr. of cust., and in charge of fire brig., May to Oct., 1904.

GRIFITH, HORACE MAJOR BRANDFORD, C.M.G. (1902).—B. 1863; ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados; confidential clk. to admtr. of Lagos, Oct., 1880; priv. sec. to lient.-gov., 1880, and clk. of legis. coun., 1882; 1st clk. and warehouse keeper at Lagos, 1883; attached to audit office, Accra, in 1884; priv. sec. to gov., G. Coast, 1885 to 1886; controller of customs, Lagos, 1889; treas., Gambia, 1894; ag. asst. col. sec. on several occasions; treas., 1891; ag. col. sec. 1894; has admstd. gov't. on various occasions between 1896 and 1899.

GRIFITH, HON. SIR SAMUEL WALKER, P.C. (1901). G.C.M.G. (1895), K.C.M.G. (1886), K.C.—B. 1845; ed. at Univ., Sydney, N.S.W.; B.A., 1868; Mort Travelling Fellowship, 1865; M.A., 1870; called to the Queensland bar, 1867; Q.C. 1876; entered the legis. assem., 1872; atty.-gen., 1874 to 1878; sec. for pub. instruction, 1876 to 1878; sec. for pub. wks., 1878 to 1879; led the opposition in the assem., 1879 to 1883; premier, col. sec., and sec. for pub. instruction, Nov., 1883; deleg. to the inter-col. convention held at Sydney, Dec., 1883; resig. office of sec. for pub. instruction, Jan., 1886; mem. of the federal coun. of Australasia, and chmn. of the standing comttee. of the fed. coun., 1886; resig. office of col. sec., Apr., 1886, and accepted newly-created office of ch. sec.; deleg. to col. counce., 1887; ch. sec. and treas., Aug., 1887; pres. of fed. coun., 1888; resig. office after gen. election, June, 1888, and became leader of opposition in assem.; again premier, and ch. sec., 1890; ch. just. of Queensland, 1893; lient.-gov., Sep., 1899; chief just. of high ct. of Australia, Sep., 1903.

GRIFITH, W. L.—Act. of the Canadian govt. in Wales for some years; sec. to high comsnr., Mar., 1903.

GRIFITH, SIR WM. BRANDFORD, KT. BACH. (1898).—Gilchrist scholar, 1877; B.A. (Lond.), 1880; called to the bar, Mid. Term., June, 1881; ag. Queen's advoc., G. Coast Col., Apr. to Oct., 1884; dist. comsnr., 1885; ag. puisne judge, Lagos, Jan., and Cape Coast, May, 1885; ag. Queen's advoc., 1886 and 1887; compiled ordinances of G. Coast Col., 1887; res. mag., Jamaica, 1888; R.M., St. Catherine, Feb., 1893; ag. atty.-gen., May to Dec., 1893; ch. just. G. Coast Col., May, 1895; admstd. gov't. of Lagos, July to Aug., 1896; dep. for gov. G. Coast, Aug. to Nov., 1897; revised ordinances of G. Coast Col., 1898.

GRIFITHS, GEORGE HOLLIER, I.S.O. (1903).—B. 1837; clk. col. sec. off., Mauritius, 1860; clk. pc.w. dept., Mauritius, 1861; ch. offr. pol. and inspr. of liberated Africans, Seychelles, 1881; ag. ch. civ. comsnr., 1884-87; inspr. of pol., Maur., 1887; ret., 1888; ag. ch. offr. pol., Sey., 1889; inspr. of rds. and jnt. conservator of crown lds., 1898; town surv. and dist. valuator for loc. bd. of hth., cent. dist., 1900; treasur. and collr. of cust., 23rd Dec., 1901; ag. crown prosecutor, Oct., 1906.

GRINDLE, G. E. A.—Scholar of Corpus Christi Coll., Oxford; 1st class classical mods., 1889; 1st class in final classical schl., 1891; B.A., 1891; elected fellow of C.C.C., 1891; Chancellor's English Essay, 1892; M.A., 1894; 2nd class clk. in local govt. board, Feb., 1893; called to the bar at Lincoln's Inn, Nov., 1895; 2nd class clk., after compet. exam., in office of S. of S. forCols., 10th Feb., 1896; asst. priv. sec. to Mr. Chamberlain, Nov., 1898; 1st class clk., 30th June, 1900.

GRINLINTON, F. H., C.M.G. (1903). B. 1853, F.R.G.S., A.I.C.E., F.R. Met. S.—Apptd. to Ceylon survey dept., Apr., 1870; dist. survr., Jan., 1877; ch. survr., Nov., 1881; ag. survr.-gen., Aug., 1894; survr.-gen., Dec., 1896; ret. June, 1904; proceeded to F.M.S. to advise govt. on reorganizn. of survey dept., Oct., 1904.

GRINLINTON, SIR J. J., KT. BACH. (1894).
