Staffs., chiefly to investigate problems in climatology; in 1881-2 established and worked the first observatory on summit of Ben Nevis, 4,406 feet high, and a station in connection at Fort William; in Jan., 1884, he established the Torrens Observatory at Wakerville, near Adelaide, and in Oct., another on the summit of Mount Lofty, S. Australia; apptd. meteor. observer of Queensland, Jan., 1887.

WRAY, Cecil, F.G.S., M.R.P.S.—Local corres., Anth. inst.; entered pub. wks. dept., Perak, Oct., 1881; ag. ch. clk. of treasy., May, 1882; asst. to mag. and collr., Kinta dist., 1882; ag. collr. and mag. B. Padang, 1886; collr. and mag., Batang Padang dist., 1887; ag. supt., Lower Perak, Aug., 1889; ag. mag. and collr., Kinta, Apr., 1892; mag. and collr., Krian, June, 1892; ag. dist. mag., Lower Perak, Dec., 1894; ag. dist. mag., Kinta, Apr., 1896; ag. sen. mag., Perak, Apr., 1897; ag. chief mag. Selangor, Sept., 1897; ch. mag. Selangor, Apr., 1899; dist. mag., Kinta, Jan., 1900; dist. offr., Kinta, Jan., 1903; ag. British res., Pahang, 3rd Mar., 1904; British res., Pahang, 14th Sept., 1904.

WRAY, Chas. James Hill, L.R.C.P., L.R.C.S. (Edin.)—Surgeon, immigr. service, Queensland, 1876; health offr., Brisbane, 1879; med. offr. penal estabm't., St. Helens, and boys' reformatory, Lytton, and visiting surg. benevolent asylum, Dunwich, 1879; inspr. of orphanages, 1882; sec. to central bd. of health, 1884.

WRAY, Leonard, I.S.O. (1903), M.I.E.E., F.Z.S., M.R.P.S., cor. M.P.S., local corres. A.I., A.M.A.—B. 1852; entered pub. wks. dept., Perak govt. service, June, 1881; supt., Govt. Hill Garden, Larut, Jan., 1882; and curator, Perak state museum, Jan., 1883; also state geologist, Jan., 1890; dir. of museums, F.M.S., Mar., 1904.

WRENFORDSLEY, Sir Henry Thomas, Knt. (1883).—Ed. in France, and at Trin. Coll., Dub.; was a mem. of the old Norfolk circuit; dep. ct. judge for the metropol. dists. of Marylebone, Brompton, and Brentford, 1876; 2nd puisne judge, Mauritius, 1877; procureur and advoc.-gen., 1878; ch. just., W. Australia, 1880; represted col. at intercolm. confee. of the Australian cols., held at Sydney, 1881; ch. just. of Fiji and ch. judicial comsnr. of the W. Pacifico, Oct., 1882-3; admstr. govt. of W. Australia from Feb. to June, 1883; acted for some time as judge, sup. ct., Tasmania; puisne judge, Victoria, 1888; ch. just., Leeward Is., Oct., 1891; retired, 1901.

WRIGHT, Arthur—Supt., printing dept., Niger Coast Prot. (now So. Nigeria), 1893.

WRIGHT, Eric Blacwood, B.A., LL.B., LL.D.—Ed. at Trin. Coll., Dublin; obtained several scholarships, 1st jun. mod. and silver medallist in history, polit. econ. and law; prize-man in German and French; called to the bar, June, 1885; ch. just., Seychelles, 13th May, 1905; author of "Wright's Law of Principle and Agent," 2nd ed., 1901, and of "Saunders on Negligence," 2nd ed.

WRIGHT, G. H. Bateson.—Queen's Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1876; Denyer theological schol.; Kennicott Hebrew schol., 1876; Houghton Syriac prize; Pusey and Ellerton Hebrew schol., 1877; M.A., 1878; D.D., 1891; apptd. headmr. Queen's College, Hong-Kong, Nov., 1881; ag. inspr. of schls., Feb. to Dec., 1883; author of "Critical Translation of Book of Job"; "Was Israel ever in Egypt?" and various school books; J.P., 1885.

WRIGHT, Hon. J. Arthur, C.E., M.I.C.E., C.E.I.—Comsnr. of rly.s., dir. of pub. wks., and engrn.-in-ch., mem. of legis. coun. and exec. coun. of W. Australia, 1885-90; temporary collr. of internal and cust. revenue at Albany, W. Aust., Nov., 1897; ag. govt. res., Albany, Jan., 1898; govt. res., Apr., 1899.

WRIGHT, R. T.—Inspr. of pol., Br. Guiana, Mar., 1883; inspr. of pol., prot. of imigrts., and sec. to the bd. of health, Grenada, Apr., 1886; harbrmr., Georgetown, Br. Guiana, 1892.

WRIGHT, Wm.—Clk. to pub. trustee, S. Aust., 1885; ch. clk. to pub. trustee, and ch. clk., succession duties dept., 1891; pub. trustee and curator of convicts' estates, 1903.

WRIGHTSON, Walsh, C.M.G. (1900), M.I.C.E.—B. 1852; served articles with Chas. Fowler, Leeds; asst. to boro' engineer, Leeds, 1872; dist. engineer, P.W.D., Ceylon, 1875; seconded for serv. on Nanuwa Rly. extensions, 1883; spec. serv. to restore Kalawewa irrigation tank, 1884; on successful completion, promoted prov. engr., N.W. Prov., 1888; asst. to dir. pub. wks., 1892; prov. engr., E. Prov., 1894; dir. pub. wks., Trinidad, and offl. mem. legis. coun., Jan., 1896; apptd. mem. ex. coun., June, 1896; res. engr., harbour, water and sewerage wks., 1896.

Wrixon, The Hon. Sir Henry John, K.C.M.G. (1892).—B. 1839; atty-gen., Victoria, Feb., 1886; resig., Nov., 1890; mem. of Federation Confce., 1891; represented Victoria at Col. Confce., 1894; author of "Socialism: Notes on a Political Tour."

Wroughton, Lewis.—Sub.-inspr. Basutoland mtd. pol., 1884; ag. asst. comsnr., Quthing, 1890; asst. comsnr., Basutoland, 1891; ag. govt. sec., 1901; govt. sec., 1902.

Wyatt, Robt.—Lond. Metro. pol., 1891 to 1895; B. Hond. pol., June, 1895; asst. supt., Feb., 1902; ag. supt., May, 1902, to May, 1903; ag. dist. comsnr., Orange Walk, July to Aug., 1903; ag. dist. comsnr., Corosol, 26th Apr. to 11th July, 1906; ag. supt. pol., 14th July, 1905; J.P. for Colony; Hythe extra certif., 1899; supt. of pol., 1st Apr., 1906.

Wylie, Thos. Alexander.—Asst. traffic supt., Ceylon rly.s., 17th May, 1888; acctnt., 11th May, 1894; now asst. gen. mgr. and acctnt.

wynne, C. O., L.R.C.P. and S.E.—Dist. med. offr., St. Kitts, Leeward Is., May, 1903.

Young, Alfred Karney.—B.A., Magd. Coll., Oxon; called to the bar, In. Tem., May, 1880;
2nd clk., col. sec.'s office, Br. Honduras, Oct., 1890; ag. dist. mag., Toledo dist., Aug., 1891; priv. sec. to Sir A. Maloney, and clk. of councils, 1892; priv. sec. to admnstr. of the govt., 1895; ag. regisr.-gen., 1895-7; dist. comsnr., Orange Walk, 1898; regisr.-gen., June, 1898; ag. supptd. of police, May to Nov., 1899; J.P. for col.; crown prosecutor, legal adviser, and police mag., Seychelles, 23rd Sept., 1903; atty.-gen., B.C. Africa Prot., 17th Mar., 1906.

YOUNG, CAPT. ARTHUR H., C.M.G. (1897).—B.1884; late 27th Inniskillings; ed. at Edin. Acad., Rugby, and Sandhurst; local comdt., mil. pol., Kyrenia, Aug., 1878; asst. comsnr., Paphos, Nov., 1878; comsnr., Paphos, Sept., 1879; ditto, Famagusta, Jan., 1882; dir. of survey and prin. forest offr., 1892; mem. legis.coun., 1892; ch. sec., 1894; admtd. the govt., July to Dec., 1895, Jan.-Apl., 1898; sent on special mission to St. Vincent in connection with relief work, Nov., 1902; col. sec., S. Stlmta., June, 1906.

YOUNG, ROBT. HEYDEN.—Sub-survr., survey dept., S. Stlmta., 28th Jan., 1878; computer and draftsman, Malacca, 1st May, 1881; dist. survr., Oct., 1882; ch. survr., 12th July, 1888; senior survr., Jan., 1891; in charge of re-survey of Singapore, 4th May, 1903.

YOUNG, WILLIAM DOUGLAS.—Ed. at Charterhouse; clk. in govt. sec.'s office, Br. Guiana, Jan., 1877; ch. clk., 1889; ag. priv. sec. on several occasions, 1877-1893, to govrs. of B. Guiana, Trinidad, and G. Coast; ag. asst. govt. sec., B. Guiana, 1892-3-4-5; ag. govt. sec., Dec., 1892; ag. govt. agt. N.W. dist., 1895; asst. col. sec., Mauritius, 1895; ag. col. sec., 1896-7-8, 1900-01; admtd. govt., Mauritius, Aug., 1897; comsnr., Turks and Caicos Islands, 1901; admstr., Dominica, 19th Apr., 1906.
